unresolved.legacyText: 乌尔戈兹是一个堕落的灵魂，也是埃科瓦尔德森林的前守护者。他曾经是一位高贵的守护者，保护森林和其中的所有生命，并与居住在那里的库兹克人一起维护森林的安全。然而，在玉风石化了大部分森林后，乌尔戈兹和他的守望者追随者开始腐化。它们对生活在森林中的人类的威胁与日俱增。
unresolved.englishDraft: UrgozA corrupt soul and a former guardian of the Ekowald forest. He was a noble guardian,PreservationThe forest and all its life, together with the Kuzk people living there, maintain the safety of the forest. However, after the jade winds have petrorated most of the forests, the forest is now being destroyed by the sea.UrgozAnd his watchmen and followers are starting to corrupt. Their threats to people living in forests are increasing.

unresolved.legacyText: 由阿斯卡隆的毁灭出发，追查白斗篷、马赛特与寻火者预言。其他篇章的角色从狮子拱门一段加入主线。
unresolved.englishDraft: The destruction of Ascalon begins with the pursuit of white cape, marset and fire-hunters.Prophecies. Other chapters fromLion's ArchA section to join the main line.

unresolved.legacyText: 瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色由星岬寺开始；其他篇章角色从北方码头进入凯宁城的剧情。
unresolved.englishDraft: The plague struck Kashan, and East Wing and the Moon led the heroes to pursue the White Shadow.Shing Jea Monastery Started; other chapters of the role from the North Pier into Kening City.

unresolved.legacyText: 伊洛那日戟军对抗瓦蕾丝与阿巴顿的势力。伊洛那角色从伊斯坦训练开始；外来角色通过 Battle Preparations 等任务加入，随后衔接领事馆码头。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Irona Japanese legiones fought against the forces of Wallace and Abbadon. The Ilona role began with the Istanbul training; outsiders passed. Battle Preparations Wait for the mission to join and then connect.Consulate Docks。

unresolved.legacyText: 地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联合阿苏拉、诺恩和黑檀先锋队，对抗大毁灭者。
unresolved.englishDraft: The earthquake and the destroyer threaten to engulf Tyrea.Eye of the Northand united Assula, Noon and Black Honolulu to fight against the Great Destroyer.

unresolved.legacyText: 毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在夏尔入侵中组织抵抗，随后率难民越过席娃山脉；他在霜门的撤离途中牺牲。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the training before destruction had ended, the role arrived in Ascalon two years later. Prince Rouric organized resistance during the Shire invasion and then led refugees across the Siva Mountains; he died on his way to the fall of the Frost Gate.

unresolved.legacyText: 抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向时，他们发现白斗篷献祭无辜者，转而与光刃并肩作战；马基斯的背叛迫使众人撤离。
unresolved.englishDraft: When they arrive in Corita, heroes help the white cape to defend itself from the dead. When they track down those who have been selected, they find that the white cloak is a sacrifice for innocent people and instead fights with a bare blade;MarkisThe betrayal forced people to evacuate.

unresolved.legacyText: 在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙格琳特的巢穴。格琳特揭示白斗篷主人是马赛特，并解释寻火者预言。
unresolved.englishDraft: Under the guidance of Turi Osa, heroes enter the nest of the giant Lungrint through three battles to test and mirror them. Gretel reveals that the owner of the white cloak is Marcelte and explains the fire-hunters.Prophecies。

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，随后帮助矮人夺回雷云要塞。
unresolved.englishDraft: Hero rescues the blade, contacts the Prophet and gets injected to defend him from the ghost pain of Marset, then helps the dwarfs recover it.Thunderhead Keep。

unresolved.legacyText: 基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露巫妖身份，试图借欧尔权杖控制泰坦。英雄最终击败巫妖，再次封闭大门。
unresolved.englishDraft: Kirblon led the hero to break the seal of the Comarie Gate and release Titan. He then exposed himself as a witch, trying to control Titan with his Orbian staff. The hero eventually defeated the demon and closed the gate again.

unresolved.legacyText: 主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方的泰坦首领。这是后续任务，不能与最终主线任务混为一项。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the end of the main line, Glynt led his hero to stop the uncontrolled Titan attacks and pursue the northern Titans. This is a follow-up mission that cannot be confused with the final main line mission.

unresolved.legacyText: 东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的标记，随后赴凯宁城求援。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dong Go and students found plague at the Minister Cao Manor, traced it to Sen Tai County and identified the white shadow markings before going to Kening City for help.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在薇茹广场被白影杀死，又由使者复活。为对抗灵魂与白影，他们完成纳普区的试炼，成为 Weh no Su，并在谭纳凯神殿释放古代英雄。
unresolved.englishDraft: The heroes were killed by the white shadows in Viru Square, and the Messenger was raised. They finished fighting against the soul and the white.Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)♪ The test, becomes Weh no SuAndTahnnakai Temple (explorable area) Release the ancient heroes.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关闭裂隙，却得知圣物只能暂时阻止白影。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero gets the urn of St. Victor and the spear of Achmores,Sunjiang District (explorable area) Close the cracks, but it was learned that sacred objects could only temporarily stop the white shadow.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的幼龟。面对共同的瘟疫威胁，两方形成合作，故事在沉睡之水重新汇合。
unresolved.englishDraft: A hero can help keep Kuzko safe.The Eternal Grove (explorable area) Or help Lecson.PreservationGyala Hatchery (explorable area)The turtles. In the face of a common plague, we have a partnership.Unwaking Waters (explorable area)Reconnect.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝牺牲，白影借皇族之血重返人间；英雄随后在帝国圣所击败他。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero has removed the shadow from control of the salt Quinnawi and has invaded.Raisu Palace East Go is the king's salvation, and the shadow returns to the world with blood from the royal family; the hero is now in the house.Imperial Sanctum Beat him.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶特与海盗合作，并得知瓦蕾丝试图释放阿巴顿。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese recruits resisted pirates, pursued the symptoms of ancient monuments, discovered that General Corina had taken Kait to cooperate with pirates and learned that Wallace was trying to release Abatton.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过科瑞纳进入瓦比；一段任务取决于选择玛格丽特或密语大师。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese army is here.Consulate DocksThe hero rescues his companions and crosses Corinne into Wabbi; a mission depends on choosing Margaret or the master of Mystery.

unresolved.legacyText: 瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎诺要塞路线；之后可选择救援罗鳩村，或夺回瑟伯欣花园。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero of the previous choice decided on the path to the front court in Dasha or fort Zhocanor; he could then choose to rescue Rohian village or take back the Saberhin Garden.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，并在摩拉废墟击败瓦蕾丝；此时黑暗逆袭已经侵入现实。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes trade with Parava York, learn to ride the giant insect through deadly.The Brimstone♪ The zone, andRuins of Morah Beating Wallace; right nowNightfallWe've got a break into reality.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫妖与白影。阿巴顿被击败后，逸散的力量威胁整个领域；寇米尔承接这股力量，成为掌管真相、知识与秘密的新神。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes met Komir in the torment, freed their trapped souls and wereGate of Madness Beating the Shaman and the White Shadow. Abbadon was defeated, and he got away.Strength Threatening the whole area; Komir takes over this.StrengthAnd become a new god in charge of truth, knowledge and secrets.

unresolved.legacyText: 角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并抵达北方之眼，与关及黑檀先锋队会合。
unresolved.englishDraft: The characters went underground from their own continent's seismic missions, met Ogden and Vic and arrived.Eye of the North Joining the Guang and Black Honolulu vanguards.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用魔像突袭毁灭者巢穴。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero called together Assula scholars like Ulla, Ged and Lenk.PreservationAnd the Shaitans plan, and raid with them the den of the destroyers.

unresolved.legacyText: 关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士皮雷合作，最终突袭要塞并解救兰玛队长等人。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Guang and the hero are looking for the missing Black Honolulus, and the Shire fire that fights the Samans.Warrior Pire cooperated, eventually raiding forts and rescued Captain Lama et al.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地，赢得诺恩的支持。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero helped Jorah to end up being the brother of the Norn bear, take back his home and...PreservationNorn's holy place, won Norne's support.

unresolved.legacyText: 盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪式，让多数矮人化为石矮人。联军深入中央传送室，击败大毁灭者，瓦解毁灭者的协同行动。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the ally was assembled, heroes gained their ancient powers in the heart of Sheva. Jarris held a Dwarve ceremony to turn most of them into rock dwarves. The coalition forces went deep.Central Transfer Chamber"and defeat the destroyer and destroy his concerted actions.

unresolved.legacyText: 前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这里并非三条互斥分支。
unresolved.englishDraft: The first three desert tasks can be accomplished in any order, but the flight process needs to be fully completed; not all three branches of each other are here.

unresolved.legacyText: 预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任务都是通关必做条件。
unresolved.englishDraft: PropheciesThe fact that some of the previous tasks are allowed to be bypassed is a storyline and does not mean that each mission is subject to customs clearance.

unresolved.legacyText: 永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两条阵营路线。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Eternal Grove (explorable area)withGyala Hatchery (explorable area)It is an alternative route; the continuation of the main line does not require the completion of two camps in sequence.

unresolved.legacyText: 三项任务分别要求 Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three mandates require each of them. Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: Pogahn Passage 与 Rilohn Refuge 是替代路线，分别要求 Margrid the Sly 与 Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks 和 Moddok Crevice 要求 Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery 要求 Koss；Kodonur Crossroads 要求 Zhed Shadowhoof。
unresolved.englishDraft: Pogahn Passage with Rilohn Refuge It's an alternative route. Separate requests. Margrid the Sly with Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks and Moddok Crevice Request Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery Request Koss；Kodonur Crossroads Request Zhed Shadowhoof。

unresolved.legacyText: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion 二选一；Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay 也只需一项继续主线，后两者并非永久互斥。分别检查 Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni 的随队要求；Grand Court of Sebelkeh 要求 Tahlkora。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion Two or one;Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay You can also check separately. Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni (a) The accompanying request;Grand Court of Sebelkeh Request Tahlkora。

unresolved.legacyText: 分别要求 Zhed Shadowhoof 与 General Morgahn 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: Separate requests Zhed Shadowhoof with General Morgahn Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: 第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，最终需要全部完成；诺恩线中的后两条任务也有并列前置关系。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three storylines of Act II, Assula, the vanguard and Norn, can move in any order that ultimately requires all of them; the latter two tasks on the Norn line are also parallel.

numeric.english: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外 1…2…2 名邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点砍击伤害。

numeric.english: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.
numeric.chinese: 精英宠物攻击。宠物尝试发动凶猛冲击，造成额外 13…25…28 点伤害。命中时，你获得怒气和 3…9…10 点能量。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.
numeric.chinese: 精英弓术攻击。移除你的所有准备技能。向目标及其最多 5 名邻近敌人射箭，命中时各造成额外 5…17…20 点伤害。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 点体力；若该盟友体力低于 50%，额外治疗 30…98…115 点体力。

numeric.english: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英纹章。将自身所有负面病症转移给目标敌人，持续时间为各病症剩余时间的 100…180…200%。诅咒属性不高于 4 时有 50% 失败几率。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 1…8…10 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，该目标受到 7 点伤害；附近所有其他敌人受到该伤害的 75%。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 2…8…9 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，你获得 3 点能量。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持续 25…53…60 秒，与风、火、水、土四系元素调和，这四项属性提高 1…2…2。每次使用这些元素的魔法时，获得 1 点能量，加上该技能基础能量消耗的 50%。

numeric.english: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 精英降咒。目标受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害。若你的能量高于目标，该目标额外受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害，并在 1…4…5 秒内移动速度降低 90%。

numeric.english: Elite Hammer Attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英鎚术攻击。击倒目标敌人及其所有邻近敌人。精通鎚术不高于 4 时，有 50% 几率失败。

numeric.english: Elite Skill. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health, an additional 20 armor, and you take -1…8…10 less damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英技能。持续 20 秒，体力上限增加 90…258…300，护甲增加 20，所受伤害减少 1…8…10 点。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英弓术攻击。命中时，除本技能外的所有技能立即完成冷却。未命中时，你的所有技能被禁用 10…5…4 秒。专精不高于 7 时，有 50% 几率未命中。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…38…45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50…210…250% of the Energy cost of the spell.
numeric.chinese: 精英 加持咒文. 用于 10…38…45 秒,你拿着 33减少敌方在战争影响下造成的损害的百分比 水系魔法 斧头. 每当你投出元素咒语, 所有非精神盟友的耳光 被治愈 50…210…250占总和的百分比 能量 咒语的代价。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持续 36…55…60 秒，你和目标盟友各自每有一点能量上限，便增加 1…3…3 点体力上限。初次施加此加持时，你和目标各获得 1…10…12 点能量；你的能量储存属性每有 2 点，你额外获得 1 点能量。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持续 40…60 秒，你的各项元素属性提高 1。每次施放法术时，能量储存每有 10 级，你获得 1 点能量，并恢复相当于该法术能量消耗 100…300% 的体力。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持续 40…60 秒，你的各项元素属性提高 1。每次施放法术时，能量储存每有 10 级，你获得 1 点能量，并恢复相当于该法术能量消耗 100…300% 的体力。

numeric.english: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英信号。 用于 5…17…20 秒,所有灵魂你控制 在耳机攻击 33更快和交易的% 5…9…10 额外的破坏。

numeric.english: Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20…35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35…60 Health when this shout ends.
numeric.chinese: 战嚎。持续 4 秒，领导属性每有 2 级再延长 1 秒；音量所及范围内所有队伍成员承受的伤害降低 20…35%。此战嚎结束时，受影响的队伍成员恢复 35…60 点体力。

numeric.english: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外 1…2…2 名邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点砍击伤害。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Rotwing Recurve Bow is one of the items added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* An easy way to get this item to drop is to tackle Rotscale while disguised as Keiran Thackeray in the Hearts of the North mini-mission, A Vengeance of Blades.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Ranger Forgotten Recurve Bow (unique)
**Ranger Forgotten Shortbow (unique)
**Ranger Keiran's Bow (Rotwing) (unique)
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 旋翼反曲弓 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的物品之一。
* 掉落该物品的一个简单方法是在北方之心迷你任务“刀锋复仇”中伪装成 Keiran Thackeray 对付 旋转鳞片。
* 其他具有此外观的物品：
**游侠 被遗忘的反曲弓（独特）
**游侠 被遗忘的短弓（独特）
**游侠 Keiran的弓（Rotwing）（独特）

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Forgotten Fan was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Necromancer Frozen Fan (unique)
**Ritualist Tattered Fan (unique)
This item has serious clipping issues on female monks, female necromancers and female mesmers.
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 被遗忘的扇子 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的武器之一。
* 其他具有此外观的物品：
**死灵 冰冻风扇（独特）
**祭祀 破烂扇子（独特）
该物品对女僧侣、女死灵法师和女催眠师有严重的剪裁问题。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Totem Axe was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* The Totem Axe has a unique skin.
* The enchantments and energy boost make this item (plus Little John, Padraic, Rajazan's Fervor, Spirit of the Forgotten and Sharp Pointy Stick) especially popular among 55 monks/necromancers and Vow of Silence runners along with many other spellcasters.
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 图腾斧 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的武器之一。
* 图腾斧有独特的皮肤。
* 附魔和能量提升使该物品（加上小约翰、帕德莱克、拉贾赞的热情、被遗忘者的灵魂 和尖头棒）在 55 僧侣/死灵法师和 沉静誓约 奔跑者以及许多其他施法者中特别受欢迎。

numeric.english:

Wiki notes: * The two chances for a halved casting time are independent, and therefore calculated multiplicatively, giving a 36% chance to half casting time.
** Related to this calculation of two 20% events, there are two player terms that refer to associated modifiers:
*** 20/20 for caster items that have 20% chances to half casting time and recharge time, respectively.
*** 40/20/20 for staves that have two HCT modifiers, like this item, but use a 20% enchanting modifier rather than +30hp.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Necromancer Bellok's Staff (unique)
**Necromancer Spinal Staff
**Elementalist Unending Night's Grasp (unique)
numeric.chinese:
维基 备注：* 两次半铸造时间的机会是独立的,因此计算成倍,从而提供 36半个铸造时间的机会
 ** 与计算两个有关。 20 %事件,有两个玩家术语指相关的修饰符:
*** 20/20 供有下列物品的铸造者使用: 20分别获得一半的投影时间和回放时间的机率%.
*** 40/20/20 用于有两根重联调制器的分节点,例如此项,但使用 20迷人的修饰剂而不是+30汉字。
 * 具有这种外观的其他物品:

numeric.english: Chest rules: Fendi's Chest will spawn after defeating Soul of Fendi Nin in the final level of the Shards of Orr dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Shards of Orr 最终击败芬迪·宁之灵魂后 将产生产卵 欧尔残迹 地牢,我们去地牢吧 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,在正常模式下会收到从投放列表中取出的一个物品(PDF).2 )),在硬模式下使用. 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

numeric.english: Chest rules: The Prismatic Chest is the end chest of the Ooze Pit dungeon and will spawn when the three Prismatic Oozes and the two Hulking Volatile Oozes that each spawns are slain. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one Prismatic Gelatinous Material, as well as one item from the drop list in normal mode (two in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：电话 副本奖励：Ooze Pit 是一个端口的胸口 乌兹地窖 地牢,当三个大乌兹和两个浩克伏活活火山被杀死时, 就会产下卵子,每个卵子都死了。 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,并会得到一款"Prismatic Gelatinos"("Gelatinous"(意为"取出"))材料,以及从平时模式下放列表中取出一款("硬模式下取出两款"). 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

numeric.english: Chest rules: Murakai's Chest is the end of dungeon reward for the Cathedral of Flames. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one Exquisite Surmia Carving, as well as one item from the following list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Cathedral of Flames 地牢的终结 奖励 火焰大教堂. 派对中的每位玩家可以打开胸口并获得一款精准的"Surmia活字雕刻",以及从以下列表中以正常方式获得一件物品(以"活字画"为主.2 )),在硬模式下使用. 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

numeric.english: Chest rules: Hidesplitter's Chest will spawn after defeating Rragar Maneater and Hidesplitter in the final level of the Rragar's Menagerie dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported to Doomlore Shrine after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Rragar's Menagerie  在最后一级击败了Rragar Maneter和Hidespliter后,将产生产卵。 拉喀的牢笼 地牢,我们去地牢吧 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,在正常模式下会收到从投放列表中取出的一个物品(PDF).2 )),在硬模式下使用. 每一个玩家打开胸口后,一个倒计时器就会开始,派对会被运送到 末日传说神殿 3分钟后

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and players will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: See: Dwarven brawling#Recommended equipment
* If doing Dwarven brawling only, for best results, apply the following modifications to increase the damage substantially (along with other benefits):
** Inscription: Brawn over Brains (+15% damage; the -5 energy is irrelevant, since the loss of energy is negated by Dwarven Brawling).
** Dagger Tang: Vampiric (minor healing while fighting), Sundering (extra damage), or Furious (faster adrenaline build).
** Dagger Handle: of Shelter (of Defense is almost as useful)
** Customization (if not sharing between characters).

* If you do not meet the required rank of 9 in Dagger Mastery, these will do 1-3 dmg, less than the default Brass Knuckles.
* You can use an identification kit on this item, but it will have no effect.
numeric.chinese:
维基 备注：参见:德华人争吵#推荐装备.
 * 如果只进行Dwarven争吵,为了取得最佳效果,应适用下列修改来大大增加损害(以及其他好处):
 ** 说明: " 脑 " (+)15损坏百分比;5 能源无关紧要,因为能源损失被德瓦文·布朗林所抵消.
 ** 唐剑:阴阳相通(在战斗中轻伤)、下行相通 (外伤)或怒气相通 怒气 建(建).
 ** 刀剑:庇护所(国防几乎同样有用)
 ** 自定义(如果不是字符之间共享的话).

 * 如果达不到规定的军衔, 9 内 匕首精通,这些会做 1-3 dmg,比默认的 Brass Knuckles 少.
 * 您可以使用此项目的身份识别包, 但不会产生任何效果。

numeric.english: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).

numeric.english:
* Unthet Rotwood has five possible spawn locations in the Frozen Forest, which it shares with four other Pinesoul bosses - Afrhul Deeproot, Arkhel Havenwood, Esnhal Hardwood, and Obrhit Barkwood.
* Every Pinesoul boss is accompanied by 3 Ice Imps.

Unlike most Pinesoul, this boss is non-fleshy (and thus his corpse cannot be exploited and he is immune to disease, bleeding, and poison). This may be intentional, as it is the only necromancer plant in prophecies, with a name "Rotwood" that suggest that it is an undead tree.
numeric.chinese:
* 温特·罗特伍德 5个产卵地点可能位于 冰冻森林和另外四个松果尔老板分享 富尔德根 阿克赫尔·哈文伍德, 埃斯纳尔硬木,以及 奥布希特·巴克伍德.
每一个松果头都伴着 3 冰块之指.

与大多数平苏尔不同,这位老板是非花样活泼的(因此他的尸体不能被利用,他可以免疫疾病,出血和毒药).  这也许是有意的,因为它是预言中唯一一种花花果植物,其名称"罗特伍德"(Rotwood)暗示它是一棵不死树.

numeric.english:
* Shares his spawn point with Valetudo Rubor, Maligo Libens, Moles Quibus and Scelus Prosum.
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.
numeric.chinese:
* 与他分享产卵点 瓦莱图多·鲁博尔, 马利戈·利本斯, 鼹鼠奎布斯 财务报告和已审计财务报表 塞鲁斯·普罗苏姆.
 * 五个老大都在四个地点产卵。  两个西部地方其实是一个大片地区,有三个老板. 其余两个产卵点各有一个老板.
 * 在西部产卵点,可以看到一位老板巡逻,而另外两位则会在大约2个位置后从熔岩中产出。 5 几分钟。

* Unlike other zombies, it does not take double damage from holy damage.

** Holy Blessing for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.
* While Rotscale can be killed during A Vengeance of Blades, doing so will not complete the related Zaishen Bounty.

Ranger Hunter Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. This mask is available with either a Marksmanship or Expertise attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. numeric.english:
Ranger Hunter Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. This mask is available with either a Marksmanship or Expertise attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all ranger attribute bonuses. 



* This mask is available for ranger PvP-only characters to create as starter armor as PvP Archer Mask with +1 Marksmanship or PvP Hunter Mask with +1 Expertise. It is also available as a Basic PvP reward for +1 of any ranger attribute as Hunter Mask.
numeric.chinese:
游侠 · Hunter Mask 是一个在 $2 中引入的口罩艺术类型 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 竞选活动。 面具可以使用,有的可以使用 弓术  或者说 专精 对所有装甲评级低于最大值的口罩给予属性奖励。  在最高装甲等级下,这个面具可以使用所有测距器属性奖金来设计. 



 * 此掩码可供护林员 PvP 仅限字符使用,以创建起动装甲像 Pvp Archer 遮罩, 并带有 +1 弓术 或 PvP 猎人面具带有 +1 专精. 也可作为+的基本PvP奖励1 任何护林员属性 猎人面具。

numeric.english:
Ranger Traveler Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a Wilderness Survival attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all ranger attribute bonuses. 



* This mask is available for ranger PvP-only characters to create as starter armor with +1 Wilderness Survival, and is also available as a Basic PvP reward for +1 of any ranger attribute.
* This mask clips with several male ranger hairstyles.

numeric.english:
Monk Labyrinthine armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign in the May 24th, 2007 update. 

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor, and there is also another prestige variant called Monk Flowing armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* This armor uses the same inventory icons as Monk Dragon armor.
* The necklace can only be seen if your guild cape is turned off.
* The female version's legs will occasionally clip through the skirt when raised high; this is easily seen during the dance animation.

 * 装甲被贴上标签 马翰石穴 独装甲在"抵抗"纪念碑 在战争中 史记殿堂.
 * 此装甲使用与 僧侣 · Dragon.
 * 只有关了你的盾牌披风才能看到项链。
 * 女性版的腿会偶尔被高高地抬起后从裙子上被夹住;这在舞蹈动画中很容易被看到.

numeric.english:
Necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern is a face scar pattern art introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. It is also available in Prophecies as part of the Initiate's set (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from collectors. Below maximum armor rating in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional attribute bonus, all Necromancer attributes except Soul Reaping are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.
numeric.chinese:
死灵法师 · Ragged Scar Pattern 是一个在 3⁄4 ̄ ̧漯B 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 运动和 北方之眼 扩张。 也可在下列网址查阅: 预言 启动集( 包含)死灵 起动装甲)或从收藏家处进行交易. 低于最高装甲等级 预言,它被设计 带有可选属性奖金,所有 死灵 属性除外 灵魂吸取 已备有。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

死灵 恶魔刀疤图案(Devilish Scar Pattern)是美国海军陆战队的装甲兵部队在1952年使用的一种名称变体. 预言 竞选活动。 装甲等级以下,它被设计成 灵魂吸取 属性奖金。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

It is also available in Prophecies as part of the Initiate's set (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from collectors. Below maximum armor rating in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional attribute bonus, all Necromancer attributes except Soul Reaping are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.
numeric.chinese:
死灵法师 · Ragged Scar Pattern 是一个在 3⁄4 ̄ ̧漯B 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 运动和 北方之眼 扩张。 也可在下列网址查阅: 预言 启动集( 包含)死灵 起动装甲)或从收藏家处进行交易. 低于最高装甲等级 预言,它被设计 带有可选属性奖金,所有 死灵 属性除外 灵魂吸取 已备有。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

死灵 恶魔刀疤图案(Devilish Scar Pattern)是美国海军陆战队的装甲兵部队在1952年使用的一种名称变体. 预言 竞选活动。 装甲等级以下,它被设计成 灵魂吸取 属性奖金。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

numeric.english:
Elementalist Third Eye is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and is also craftable throughout the campaign, except at max armor rating. It is only available from crafters. It does not provide an attribute bonus.
An exception to this is the Third Eye given by Professor Yakkington in Pre-Searing which grants a bonus of Item's Attribute +1. It is also available in Nightfall, but only as starter headgear.
numeric.chinese:
元素使 · Third Eye 是一种在 预言 运动是起跑装甲,除最高装甲等级外,在整个战役中也是可制的。 只能从手工艺者那里获得。  它不提供属性奖金。
雅克京顿教授在"封口前"中给出的"第三眼"例外,它授予了"物品属性+"的奖金.1. 也可在下列网址查阅: 黑暗逆袭,但只是作为启动头盔。

Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. 
The Stone Summit Warders should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive area of effect damage.
The other main target should be Stone Summit Defenders because they have Power Drain and Waste Not, Want Not allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt

*Anti-knock down, there are large mobs of Modniir on the path to Justiciar Thommis.

numeric.english:
Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
**The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
numeric.chinese:
一旦玩家进入产卵点位置的雷达范围,哈恩或马克辛就会产卵并开始在岛上周围巡逻. 老板会逆时针走巡逻路线 所以最好顺时针顺着巡逻路线走 当老板在生下孩子的时候朝你走去 而你却不需要通过无数的暴徒追赶老板  如果你顺时针走过巡逻路线, 就会有一群暴徒 和马赫高水手在外边的一圈巡逻 残火营地.  你的派对可以待在复活圣殿附近 召集每个暴徒

技能建议
 如果你顺时针走过巡逻路线:
只能遇到咒语相伴的暴徒(Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras,和幽灵相伴),所以考虑带来反咒语的技巧和/或各种 游侠 自然仪式,可以使你的党受益,但不能使敌人的拼写者受益(例如: 风(黑檀), 怒火,自"黑暗火焰干燥器"使用Chilblains后,还有"温诺宁"的毒性.
唯一实际攻击者是 骨头 由花纹怪兽通过动画创造的小精灵 骨头 弱小的,所以技能 阻断,导致失明, 或造成盲症在这里是无效的。
 *这项征程最早于4月提出 25, 2009.
 *如果你顺时针走出老板的巡逻道,你可以借此机会得到火山岩.
赫恩或马克辛有可能在他们北边的海滩上产卵

numeric.english:
*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.
**Some areas have variable spawns (e.g. Pockmark Flats); rezoning a few times will address this.
**He has sometimes failed to spawn due to the War in Kryta (e.g. in Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)); if not previously fixed by ArenaNet, you can work around this by using a character who has not started WiK or dropping any relevant bounties for characters that have finished WiK.
**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.

*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.

**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.

numeric.chinese:
完成前面的任务后，该任务会自动添加到任务日志中。与大多数任务不同，它不能被放弃。这是由于无法重新获得它。

一旦你离开北方车站并在外面与乔拉交谈，你可以步行回去或绘制地图回到车站，再次离开，并在复活神社收集诺恩赏金。如果你继续直接前往北方之眼，你就无法到达它，直到沿着路径走得更远。

numeric.english: Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.

numeric.english: Part 3: Return to Rata Sum and exit into Magus Stones, follow quest map 2. Along the way, you will encounter 24 spiders (rangers, paragons, and monks); there are five groups, two of which are popups. You can directly zone into Alcazia Tangle or considering first killing the nearby group of Krait to obtain an additional Asura rank bonus.
numeric.chinese: 第三部分：返回拉塔苏姆，进入魔法石，按照任务地图2走。一路上，你会遇到24只蜘蛛（游侠、典范和僧侣）；有五个组，其中两个是弹出窗口。你可以直接进入阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区，或者考虑先杀死附近的金环蛇群以获得额外的阿修罗等级奖励。

numeric.english: At the beginning of the 2nd level, Livia or Gadd can get stuck at the bottom of the stairs in the corner. As with any NPC allies, watch that they stay with the party to avoid backtracking later.
numeric.chinese: 在第二关开始时，莉维亚或加德可能会被困在角落里的楼梯底部。与任何 NPC 盟友一样，注意他们留在队伍中，以免日后反悔。

numeric.english: Lead Hamar against the skree harpies holding Dohjok quarry. [5...0] of 5 harpy groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 带领哈马尔对抗占据多赫约克采石场的斯克雷鹰身女妖。剩余 5 个鹰身女妖组中的 [5...0]。

numeric.english: If you have fewer than seven heroes unlocked, consider playing in hard mode, which raises the henchmen to level 20.
numeric.chinese: 如果您解锁的英雄少于 7 个，请考虑玩困难模式，这会将追随者提升至 20 级。

numeric.english: Consider bringing skills that protect against elemental damage since 10 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause elemental damage.
numeric.chinese: 考虑携带可以防止元素伤害的技能，因为在此任务中 22 种敌人中有 10 种拥有会造成元素伤害的技能。

numeric.english: Consider bringing Mantra of Flame, since 8 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause fire damage.
numeric.chinese: 考虑带上火焰咒语，因为在这个任务中 22 种敌人中有 8 种拥有造成火焰伤害的技能。

numeric.english: Cowl Fiercetongue uses Ward Against Harm, so it is not necessary for a party member to bring it.
numeric.chinese:
风帽猛舌使用的是防伤害结界，所以党员不需要携带它。

MAPPINGOUT_a25085dcef7746f_0
避免携带血歌，因为凶猛先知会使用它。

numeric.chinese: 清除伊斯努尔群岛上的远古亡灵。您还剩下 4 个组中的 [4..0] 个。

numeric.chinese: 从梅赫塔尼群岛清除远古不死生物。您还剩下 3 个组中的 [3..0] 个。

击败大祭司烧魂和所有敌对势力。

numeric.english: Zoning out of the Cliffs of Dohjok before completing the quest causes it to be reset. Although your quest log will show you having collected 1 of the 6 scroll pieces, this is the piece acquired earlier during Big News, Small Package.
numeric.chinese: 在完成任务之前划出多赫约克悬崖会导致任务被重置。虽然你的任务日志会显示你已经收集了 6 个卷轴碎片中的 1 个，但这是之前在《大新闻，小包裹》期间获得的碎片。

numeric.english: Find the 2 ingredients needed to make an antidote for the coming sickness, nong berries and tai ling buds. You have found [0..2] of 2 ingredients.
numeric.chinese: 找到为即将到来的疾病制作解药所需的 2 种成分：农浆果和太灵花蕾。您已找到 [0..2] 种成分。

numeric.english: At the completion of this mission, you could have up to eight party members in Sunspear Great Hall (exceeding that outpost's normal party size); you can use this to vanquish the Plains of Jarin.
numeric.chinese: 完成此任务后，阳矛大厅中的队伍成员数量最多可达 8 名（超出了该前哨站的正常队伍规模）；你可以用它来征服贾林平原。

numeric.english: Note that the Quest Log indicates to "follow the Flame Keepers", but the name of the Charr the party must follow is "Ember Bearer". Sometimes Breena doesn't appear at point 2, possibly killed by the Charr boss near her. When this happens, you'll have to restart the mission and try again. The Flame that the Ember Bearers carry can get stuck on the wall of the tar pit or any minions, the Ember Bearers will carry on but when they get to the gate it doesn't open. However, if you pull them near The Flame and run off it will begin to follow them again. Sometimes the Ember Bearers will get caught at the gate they enter through and prevent the exit gate from being opened. The bonus is still completable as long as the entrance gate opens, but you will not be able to use the exit gate as a shortcut.
numeric.chinese: 请注意，任务日志指示“跟随火焰守护者”，但队伍必须跟随的夏尔的名字是“灰烬持有者”。有时布瑞娜不会出现在第二点，可能是被她附近的查尔老大杀死的。发生这种情况时，您必须重新启动任务并重试。灰烬持有者携带的火焰可能会卡在焦油坑的墙上或任何小兵上，灰烬持有者会继续前进，但当他们到达大门时，门不会打开。然而，如果你把它们拉到火焰附近并逃跑，它会再次开始跟随它们。有时，灰烬持有者会在他们进入的大门处被抓住，并阻止出口大门打开。只要入口门打开，奖励仍然可以完成，但你将无法使用出口门作为捷径。

numeric.english: You have [3...0] of 3 Kournan field marshal groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 您还剩下 3 个库尔南陆军元帅小组中的 [3...0] 个。

numeric.english: Take Koss as one hero and go into the Sunward Marches. You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them. Go northwest and afterwards straight north to rescue the next two pairs. Watch out for sentry traps as they will cause 100 armor-ignoring damage to anyone in the area every 5 seconds. Talk to Commander Suha in the northeast to gain access to Venta Cemetery.
numeric.chinese: 以科斯为英雄之一，前往向阳进军。 You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them.向西北走，然后一直向北去营救接下来的两对。小心哨兵陷阱，因为它们每 5 秒会对区域内的任何人造成 100 点无视护甲伤害。与东北方的苏哈指挥官交谈，即可进入文塔墓地。

references.title: And a Hero Shall Lead Them

numeric.english: Twelve guard posts are located throughout this mission; they are marked on the map by a red flag if active and gray one if neutralized. If you approach and do not kill the guards quickly enough, you will be targeted by siege attacks. A progress bar indicates the amount of time you have, with different colors to indicate how rapidly they expire — from fastest to slowest, they are: red, blue, teal, green and gray.
numeric.chinese: 整个任务区设有 12 个哨所；如果它们处于活动状态，则它们在地图上会标有红旗；如果被中和，则标有灰色旗。如果你接近但没有足够快地杀死守卫，你将成为围攻攻击的目标。进度条指示您拥有的时间量，并用不同的颜色指示它们过期的速度 - 从最快到最慢，它们是：红色、蓝色、青色、绿色和灰色。

numeric.english: Skipping the bonus reduces the length of the mission by 66% (e.g. less than ten minutes instead of 30 minutes).
numeric.chinese: 跳过奖励会使任务长度缩短 66%（例如，少于 10 分钟而不是 30 分钟）。

numeric.english: Players who started the three required Wanted quests before the 19 November 2010 update might be forced to take the official umbrella quest, which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to Riverside Assassination, speak to Murro in Lion's Arch and add The War in Kryta to your quest log.
numeric.chinese: 在 2010 年 11 月 19 日更新之前开始三个必需的通缉任务的玩家可能会被迫接受官方的保护伞任务，否则这是可选的。如果你无法继续进行河滨刺杀，请与狮子拱门的穆罗交谈，并将科瑞塔之战添加到你的任务日志中。

numeric.english: You have [3...0] of 3 cruel Taskmasters remaining.
numeric.chinese: 您还剩下 [3...0] 个残忍的监工。

numeric.english: Players who started the three required Wanted quests before the 19 November 2010 update might be forced to take the official umbrella quest, which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to Riverside Assassination, speak to Murro in Lion's Arch and add The War in Kryta to your quest log.
numeric.chinese: 在 2010 年 11 月 19 日更新之前开始三个必需的通缉任务的玩家可能会被迫接受官方的保护伞任务，否则这是可选的。如果你无法继续进行河滨刺杀，请与狮子拱门的穆罗交谈，并将科瑞塔之战添加到你的任务日志中。

numeric.english: Method 1: Kill all the Mantle at the left shrine
numeric.chinese: 方法一：杀死左边神殿的所有斗篷

numeric.english: Route 1: Frontal assault
numeric.chinese: 路线一：正面突击

numeric.english: Route 2: Green gate
numeric.chinese: 路线二：绿门

numeric.english: Clear the way to the Fountain of Truth by defeating Justiciar Sevaan and his forces in Shaemoor. [10...0] of 10 groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 击败谢莫尔审判官塞瓦安和他的军队，扫清通往真理之泉的道路。剩余 10 组中的 [10...0]。

numeric.english: Jiaju Tai (at the pier, in Lion's Arch) takes you to the beach. From there, head to Hakewood to speak with Dinas. After he opens the gate, travel towards Temple of Tolerance. Inside the temple, you will face multiple groups of mantles from both entrances. Clear out the groups on the platforms below Koril the Malignant, to give you room to maneuver and a place to retreat. Koril calls in reinforcements when his health drops, one time each at 75%, 50%, 25% and even 10% health. Since the April 28, 2026 update, Koril will often use Well of Blood when engaged, dropping his health and immediately summoning reinforcements.
numeric.chinese: 家居台（位于狮子拱门的码头）带您前往海滩。从那里前往哈克伍德与迪纳斯交谈。打开大门后，前往宽容寺。在寺庙内部，您将在两个入口处看到多组披风。清除恶毒者科里尔下面平台上的队伍，给你回旋的空间和撤退的地方。当科里尔的生命值下降时，他会呼叫增援，每次生命值下降到 75%、50%、25% 甚至 10% 时。自 2026 年 4 月 28 日更新以来，科里尔在交战时经常会使用鲜血之井，降低生命值并立即召唤援军。

numeric.english: Destroy the demons from the earth. [3...0] of 3 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭地球上的恶魔。剩下 3 组中的 [3...0]。

numeric.english: Weaken the Drought by killing the droughtlings at the Floodplain of Mahnkelon, outside the Waterworks. [5...0] of 5 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 通过杀死水厂外马恩科隆洪泛区的旱生物来减弱干旱。剩下 5 个组中的 [5...0] 个。

numeric.english: You have followed [0...4] of Dunkoro's 4 remaining suggestions.
numeric.chinese: 您已遵循 Dunkoro 剩余 4 条建议中的 [0...4] 条。

numeric.english: You have participated in [0...5] of 5 festivities.
numeric.chinese: 您已参加了 5 个庆祝活动中的 [0...5] 个。

numeric.english: There are three main techniques for successfully defending against the siege, based on where you confront the mobs: at the gates, with the king, or by taking the fight to the teleporter.
numeric.chinese: 成功防御围攻的主要技巧有3种，具体取决于你面对暴民的地点：在门口、与国王一起战斗，或者在传送点战斗。

numeric.english: Each time you destroy a singular seal, four level-10 (lvl 20 in Hard Mode) Seal Guards will spawn while Mursaat Guardians will join the battle from the north and south. Clear the area of the current crop of foes before destroying another seal, otherwise you will get overwhelmed. As with other similar missions, patience is the key to success.
numeric.chinese: 每次你摧毁一个单一封印时，四名 10 级（困难模式下为 20 级）封印守卫就会出现，而穆萨特守护者将从北方和南方加入战斗。在摧毁另一个封印之前，先清除当前区域的敌人，否则你会不知所措。与其他类似任务一样，耐心是成功的关键。

numeric.english: Complete the trial in each chamber to open the way into the inner sanctum. [0...3] of 3 trials completed.
numeric.chinese: 完成每个房间的试炼，打开进入内部密室的道路。已完成 3 项试验中的 [0...3]。

numeric.english: [3...0] of 3 gates still stand.
numeric.chinese: 3 个城门中的 [3...0] 仍然矗立。

numeric.english: [3...0] of 3 bombards still function.
numeric.chinese: 3 枚轰炸中的 [3...0] 仍在发挥作用。

numeric.english: [4...0] of 4 generals remain.
numeric.chinese: 剩下 4 位将军中的 [4...0] 位。

numeric.english: Initially a few groups of Kournan soldiers will come towards the citadel. Focus your defense on the center with the Vabbi defenders, but you may need to travel widely to help control the Kournans. In a team with 2 or more human players, split into two teams of 4 for mobility and better defense. If you are alone it is best to stay with your team and defend the middle and the side without Vabbi defenders - Master of Whispers as a minion master is a good choice. 2 groups of Vabbi defenders will have trouble defending a side without some assistance.
numeric.chinese: 最初，几组库尔南士兵将前往城堡。将你的防守集中在瓦比后卫的中路，但你可能需要广泛移动以帮助控制库南。在有 2 名或更多人类玩家的队伍中，分成两队，每队 4 人，以提高机动性和更好的防守。如果你独自一人，最好留在你的团队中，在没有瓦比防守者的情况下防守中路和边路——密语大师作为随从大师是一个不错的选择。如果没有一些帮助，两组瓦比后卫将很难防守一支球队。

numeric.english: For the Master's reward on this mission only 5 of the 6 defensive structures need to remain.
numeric.chinese: 大师在这次任务中的奖励只需要保留 6 个防御结构中的 5 个即可。

numeric.english: Capture the torment rifts guarded by the Margonites. Stand near a rift to claim it. [0...3] of 3 rifts captured.
numeric.chinese: 占领玛贡派守卫的折磨裂缝。站在裂痕附近夺取它。已捕获 3 个裂痕中的 [0...3] 个。

numeric.english: You have defeated [0...2] of 2 additional Harbingers.
numeric.chinese: 您已击败另外 2 个先驱者中的 [0...2] 个。

numeric.english: On rare occasion, killing both additional Harbingers and their support groups will not progress the bonus objective (You have defeated [0 or 1] of 2 additional Harbingers.). Players will have to restart the mission to get master's reward. (Let the Bonus Harbingers hit you before you drop the Light and kill them, the bug seems to trigger when they get killed before they have the chance to land a single blow.)
numeric.chinese: 在极少数情况下，杀死额外的先驱者及其支持小组不会推进奖励目标（您已击败 2 个额外先驱者中的 [0 或 1] 个。）。玩家必须重新开始任务才能获得大师的奖励。 （在你放下圣光并杀死他们之前，让奖励先驱击中你，当他们在有机会进行一击之前被杀死时，该错误似乎会触发。）

numeric.english: You have defeated [0...2] of 2 additional Harbingers.
numeric.chinese: 您已击败另外 2 个先驱者中的 [0...2] 个。

numeric.english: You have saved [0...3] of 3 junundu young.
numeric.chinese: 您已拯救了 3 个 junundu 幼崽中的 [0...3] 个。

numeric.english: The Junundu Young will travel through the rocky terrain that your party must cross in human form.
numeric.chinese:
朱南杜年轻人将穿越岩石地形，你的队伍必须以人类形态穿越。

MAPPINGOUT_6bf8cfae3a1f267_0
如果你在与Aijundu交谈之前拯救了所有的幼崽，那么当你这样做时，它会说你已经拯救了3个junundu幼崽中的0个，但任务完成时你仍然会得到Master的奖励。

numeric.english: If you save all of the young before talking to Aijundu, when you do, it will say you have saved 0 of 3 junundu young, but you will still get the Master's reward when the mission is complete.
numeric.chinese: 如果你在与Aijundu交谈之前拯救了所有的幼崽，那么当你这样做时，它会说你已经拯救了3个junundu幼崽中的0个，但任务完成时你仍然会得到Master的奖励。

numeric.english: Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier.
numeric.chinese: 由于折磨生物的生成是有限的（每个生成点只有 2 个生成，每个生成点只有 2 个生成），因此可以在占领入口的同时杀死附近的所有恶魔，从而使与 Varesh 的第二形态的战斗变得更加容易。

numeric.english: Close the torment rifts by slaying the portal wraiths. [5...0] of 5 rifts remain open.
numeric.chinese: 杀死传送门幽灵来关闭折磨裂缝。 5 个裂痕中的 [5...0] 个仍然开放。

numeric.english: The Ministry foes stand around in a large group while the dialogue takes place; consider abusing this by bringing a trapper to cover the ground under them with traps that will all trigger at once when they turn hostile, effectively wiping them out, or at least thinning their numbers.
numeric.chinese:
对话期间，魔法部的敌人们围成一大群站着；考虑滥用这一点，让一个捕兽者用陷阱覆盖他们下面的地面，当他们变得敌对时，这些陷阱会立即触发，有效地消灭他们，或者至少减少他们的数量。

MAPPINGOUT_675231becdcecfb_0
当您接受此任务时，部长法令将添加到您的库存中。

numeric.english: As soon as you enter the zone, head towards Xin Ji to trigger the initial dialogue. Once that ends, start moving towards each successive quest marker; these lead you through the most efficient escape route. If you start right away, you can evade the ministry troops even after they start following you. Along the way, reinforcements will spawn, but as long as you keep moving, you will be able to lead Xin Ji to safety.
numeric.chinese:
进入区域后，前往辛吉，触发初始对话。一旦结束，开始朝每个连续的任务标记移动；这些将引导您通过最有效的逃生路线。如果你立即开始，即使部委部队开始跟踪你，你也可以躲避他们。一路上会出现援军，但只要你继续前进，就能带领辛霁安全抵达安全地带。

MAPPINGOUT_8e0bc1e7aaddd8b_0
一旦你到达 Xaquang Skyway 入口附近的桥梁，示威者就会从你的队伍窗口中移除，从而完成任务。你可以/辞职或计划或等待观看从最后一行对话之后开始的电影。

numeric.english: You have freed [0...8] souls out of 8.
numeric.chinese: 您已经释放了 8 个灵魂中的 [0...8] 个。

numeric.english: Fight the 2 pairs of Temple Guardians separately from the main group. If you're careful you should be able to sneak past the first group of Temple Guardians. As with all Afflicted groups, concentrate on their monks and powerful Ritualists first.
numeric.chinese: 与主力队伍中的两对圣殿守卫分开作战。如果你小心的话，你应该能够溜过第一组圣殿守护者。与所有受影响群体一样，首先关注他们的僧侣和强大的仪式者。

numeric.english: Pain Inverter is useful against the AoE damage of the Temple Guardians.
numeric.chinese:
疼痛反转器对于对抗圣殿守护者的 AoE 伤害非常有用。

MAPPINGOUT_ecf5faeedb9da0f_0
考虑携带火焰咒语或防止元素伤害的技能，因为受折磨的游侠、受折磨的元素使和神殿守护者都有造成火焰伤害的技能。

numeric.english: Winning the Convocation gives you access to the Spear of Archemorus, an optional and recommended bundle item that can deal a max damage of 1900 at its level five when dropped (see its cumulative power here). Take it and head towards the Kraken boss, avoid aggro while fighting it.
numeric.chinese: 赢得集会后，您将能够获得阿彻摩洛斯之矛，这是一种可选且推荐的捆绑物品，掉落时在 5 级时可造成最大 1900 点伤害（请在此处查看其累积威力）。拿着它，向海妖头目前进，在与它战斗时避免仇恨。

numeric.english: She has several deadly skills, notably Corrupted Dragon Scales (creating six creatures) and Dark Chain Lightning (which hits an initial target for 300 damage and will then hit subsequent targets, diminishing in force by 10% with each hit).
numeric.chinese: 她拥有多种致命技能，特别是腐化龙鳞（创造 6 个生物）和黑暗连锁闪电（对初始目标造成 300 点伤害，然后攻击后续目标，每次攻击威力减少 10%）。

numeric.english: Alternatively, it is possible for any character to walk into the outpost from The Eternal Grove (explorable area), but this first requires you to complete Unwaking Waters from the Luxon side and glitch through the gate from Unwaking Waters (explorable area) to Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).
numeric.chinese:
或者，任何角色都可以从永恒树林（可探索区域）走进前哨站，但这首先需要您从卢克森一侧完成不醒之水，并从不醒之水（可探索区域）到不醒之水（库兹克）的大门出现故障。

MAPPINGOUT_ec33ac744f8afeb_0
让树歌手活下来，保护永恒之树。您还剩下 [12...0] 个树歌手，共 12 个。

numeric.english: If you have access to Hard mode, then vanquishing an area is your best option - you gain more faction per kill from the Blessing of the Luxons - and vanquishing an entire zone will reward an additional faction bonus. The most efficient vanquish is in Mount Qinkai, which should take less than 25 minutes for about 10k faction.
numeric.chinese: 如果您可以进入困难模式，那么征服一个区域是您的最佳选择 - 每次击杀您都会从卢克森的祝福中获得更多派系 - 并且征服整个区域将奖励额外的派系奖励。最有效的征服是在秦开山，大约 10k 派别需要不到 25 分钟。

numeric.english: Once these foes are killed, the caravan will move towards point 7. Pick up the smoke canister and wait. A cinematic will trigger and then the Afflicted will assault both Luxons and Kurzicks from the north. They mostly come in small numbers, with only one large group, and pose little threat especially with both Kurzick and Luxon allies to help you. The Young Turtles will be far behind you, so they are at minimal risk. At the start of the fight, drop your smoke canister some way behind the gate; if you struggle, you can retreat to pull the Afflicted towards it. Do not place the canister too far forward or the slope will obstruct the Siege Turtles' line of sight. The mission will complete when the last of the Afflicted is killed.
numeric.chinese: 一旦这些敌人被杀死，商队就会前往第七点。拿起烟雾罐并等待。一段过场动画将会触发，然后受苦者将从北方攻击卢克森人和库兹克人。他们大多数量较少，只有一大群，几乎不构成威胁，尤其是在库尔齐克和卢克森盟友都来帮助你的情况下。小海龟会远远落后于你，所以他们面临的风险很小。战斗开始时，将烟雾罐扔到大门后面某处；如果你挣扎，你可以撤退，将受折磨的人拉向它。不要将罐子放置得太靠前，否则斜坡会阻碍攻城龟的视线。当最后一个受折磨者被杀死时任务就会完成。

numeric.english: Boss two, if you chose Talon, the doors to the spawn portals close and you can approach and kill the Necromancer boss with ease. If you did not choose Talon, your party should run through the middle into the Necromancer group and be careful not to aggro the growing group of Shiro'ken forming in the middle of the room.
numeric.chinese: Boss 2，如果你选择 Talon，重生传送门的门就会关闭，你可以轻松接近并杀死死灵法师 Boss。如果你没有选择利爪，你的队伍应该从中间跑进死灵法师队伍，并小心不要激怒在房间中间形成的越来越多的白肯队伍。

numeric.english: Boss four, after pulling the groups near the Elementalist boss, engage and kill the boss group. Be mindful that Ritualists and Monks tend to hide on the stairs behind the boss and can resurrect or heal without pressure. If you chose Danika, be prepared to run.
numeric.chinese: Boss 4，将队伍拉到元素师 Boss 附近后，与 Boss 队伍交战并杀死他们。请注意，仪式主义者和僧侣往往隐藏在 Boss 后面的楼梯上，并且可以毫无压力地复活或治愈。如果你选择了丹妮卡，就做好逃跑的准备。

numeric.english: Boss five, if you chose Cynn, the spawn portals are closed and you can fight your way across the bridge in the middle of the room. Once across, you must follow the multiple groups of enemies until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.
numeric.chinese: Boss 5，如果你选择 Cynn，重生传送门会关闭，你可以通过房间中间的桥杀出一条血路。一旦穿过，你必须跟随多组敌人，直到到达仪式者老板。留在地毯上以避免酸陷阱。

numeric.english: Introduced in the February 25, 2026 update.
numeric.chinese: 在 2026 年 2 月 25 日更新中引入。

numeric.english: Free the other Orrian spirits from the Leech Tunnels. You have rescued [0...3] of 3 spirits.
numeric.chinese: 将其他奥里安灵魂从水蛭隧道中释放出来。您已拯救了 3 个灵魂中的 [0...3] 个。

numeric.english: If a player with at least 51 platinum talking to Ruthless Sevad selects the "Thief! Here's your five platinum..." option but hasn't clicked the following "Here's the money..." option, the player can drop all of their gold on the ground, click the "Here's the money..." option, and pick their gold back up to skip to the reward objective without actually paying the 51 platinum.
numeric.chinese: 如果与无情塞瓦德交谈的至少 51 白金的玩家选择“小偷！这是你的 5 白金...”选项，但没有单击下面的“这是钱...”选项，则玩家可以将所有金币扔在地上，单击“这是钱...”选项，然后捡起他们的金币以跳到奖励目标，而无需实际支付 51 白金。

numeric.english: Option 1: "Thief! Here's your five platinum... and not a gold piece more."
numeric.chinese: 选项一：“小偷！这是你的五白金……不能再多了。”

numeric.english: Free the bound souls of the Imperial guards from Shiro's constructs. You have freed 0...3 of 3 souls.
numeric.chinese: 将帝国守卫被束缚的灵魂从白的构造体中解放出来。您已经释放了 3 个灵魂中的 0...3 个。

numeric.english: Behron and Sahreh are standing above the south-west tip of the quarry. At first this is a straight objective to either run to or map travel to Beknur Harbor. Dalz isn't 50 feet from the exit. The argument can seem drawn-out, but it is recommended to stand well-away from the 3 until all have turned hostile. Behron and Sahreh will turn hostile first, so if there are spirits or minions in the area, they will take after those two first. Also of note: Sahreh is a Monk, and if you send minions out of her range, she will chase them to heal them. If you have them, or have a hero who does, send them away before approaching Sahreh.
numeric.chinese: 贝伦和萨赫雷站在采石场的西南端上方。起初，这是一个直接目标，要么跑到贝克努尔港，要么绘制前往贝克努尔港的地图。达尔兹距离出口不到 50 英尺。争论可能看起来很漫长，但建议远离这三个人，直到所有人都变得敌对为止。 Behron和Sahreh会首先变得敌对，所以如果该地区有灵魂或爪牙，他们会首先攻击那两个。另外值得注意的是：Sahreh 是一名武僧，如果你将小兵送出她的范围，她会追赶他们并治愈他们。如果你有它们，或者有一个英雄有，请在接近萨赫赫之前将它们送走。

numeric.english: Several large groups of Outcasts patrol the area immediately around the Halcyon. However if you're careful you should only have to fight one group located at the left rear of the ship. The other groups will move away giving you access to the inside of the ship. Arani is inside the ship on the scaffolding (effectively the "2nd floor"), to get to her go up the ramps.
numeric.chinese: 几大群流放者在翡翠号周围区域巡逻。然而，如果你小心的话，你应该只需要与位于船左后部的一组作战。其他小组将离开，让你可以进入船的内部。阿拉尼在船内的脚手架上（实际上是“二楼”），要爬上坡道去找她。

numeric.english: Eliminate the corsairs camping out in Lahtenda Bog. 0..5 of 5 camps still remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭在拉滕达沼泽露营的海盗。 5 个营地中的 0..5 个仍然存在。

numeric.english: It's easy to get close to the children while they are standing and talking; simply get inside their little circle, and then talk to them very quickly once Nehduvad shouts to run away. It is possible to catch all 3 of them before they get past the first group of insects.
numeric.chinese: 当孩子们站着说话时，很容易拉近与他们的距离；只需进入他们的小圈子，然后一旦内杜瓦德大喊要逃跑，就很快地与他们交谈。在它们穿过第一组昆虫之前，有可能将它们全部捕获。

numeric.english: Kill insects and gather 10 Scarab Spores for Scholar Chago. 0...10 of 10 spores gathered.
numeric.chinese: 杀死昆虫并为学者查戈收集 10 个圣甲虫孢子。聚集了 10 个孢子中的 0...10 个。

numeric.english: This quest was offered for the first time on July 22, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 该任务于 2009 年 7 月 22 日首次提供。

numeric.english: To enter the Northlands, you must open the gate behind Torin by pulling the lever above it. While Torin insists you need a partner, you can pull the lever, enter the opened gate and proceed with the rest of the quest entirely on your own since the June 6, 2018 update.
numeric.chinese: 要进入北地，你必须拉动上方的杠杆来打开托林后面的大门。虽然托林坚持认为你需要一个伙伴，但自 2018 年 6 月 6 日更新以来，你可以拉动控制杆，进入打开的大门，并完全自行完成其余的任务。

numeric.english: This mission has a 10 minute time limit; however, additional time can be earned after rescuing a set number of refugees (+60 seconds every 25 people saved). Kurzick refugees come in groups of 1 - 4 from three different paths and head towards the portal. Approximately every 30 seconds, the next group spawns and makes its way toward the portal. Between the refugee spawn points and the portal is where several groups of Wardens spawn. As time progresses, more groups will spawn. Guard Karsten and Guard Uwe are standing next to the portal and will help fight any Wardens that get within range. They are not required to survive, but their presence is helpful.
numeric.chinese: 该任务有10分钟的时间限制；然而，在拯救一定数量的难民后可以获得额外的时间（每拯救 25 人+60 秒）。库尔兹克难民以 1 - 4 人为一组，从三个不同的路径涌向传送门。大约每 30 秒，下一组就会出现并朝传送门前进。在难民生成点和传送门之间是几组守望者生成的地方。随着时间的推移，将会产生更多的群体。卡斯滕警卫和乌维警卫站在传送门旁边，将帮助对抗任何进入射程内的守望者。它们并不是生存所必需的，但它们的存在是有帮助的。

numeric.english: On Level 1: an extra normal gate and several hidden rooms.
numeric.chinese: 第一层：一扇额外正常的大门和几个隐藏的房间。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on June 1st, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 该任务于 2009 年 6 月 1 日首次提供。

numeric.english: Before the November 19, 2010 update, this quest was automatically placed in your quest log after witnessing Search for Allies if The War in Kryta was active.
numeric.chinese: 在 2010 年 11 月 19 日更新之前，如果科瑞塔之战处于活动状态，则在见证“寻找盟友”后，此任务会自动放入您的任务日志中。

numeric.english: 3,500 Norn reputation points
numeric.chinese:
3,500 诺恩声望点

MAPPINGOUT_d8d0dbe77a1d107_0
从古纳尔城堡镇向北行驶，找到通往比约拉边境的传送门。该区域也紧邻长眼壁架。

numeric.english: At the foot of the path leading up to the 1,000 Daggers guild hall.
numeric.chinese: 通往千刀公会大厅的小路脚下。

numeric.english: On the bridge leading to the 1,000 Daggers guild hall, there are "blind spots" where allies and foes can become invisible. This error is also seen in Xaquang Skyway.
numeric.chinese: 通往千刀公会大厅的桥上有“盲点”，可以让盟友和敌人隐形。这个错误在 Xaquang Skyway 中也出现过。

numeric.english: Destroy the Demon Underlords to release the magical bindings placed on the entrance to the spawning tunnels. 0...2 of 2 Demon Underlords remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭恶魔霸主，释放放置在产卵隧道入口处的魔法束缚。剩余 2 个恶魔领主中的 0...2 个。

numeric.english: If you can use a tank as a barrier, keeping the enemies at a distance, this quest becomes a lot easier versus having your whole party take the aggro. Also, the monoliths to your right as you enter the area will inevitably be aggroed at some point, so you may as well pull them over early, either before the waves start or at least during the early, easier waves. For this quest, your Lightbringer skills and title will be invaluable.
numeric.chinese:
如果你可以使用坦克作为屏障，使敌人保持一定距离，那么这个任务就会变得比让你的整个队伍承担仇恨要容易得多。此外，当你进入该区域时，你右边的巨石将不可避免地在某些时候被攻击，所以你最好尽早把它们拉过来，要么在波浪开始之前，要么至少在早期、更容易的波浪期间。对于这个任务，你的光明使者技能和头衔将是无价的。

MAPPINGOUT_1297e6acad25d38_0
在任务The Oddbodies期间，你将有6个额外的盟友，他们可以在不死的情况下对抗3波恶魔（不过你必须先从堕夜之地之门开始招募他们）。只要尝试尽快击倒每一波即可。

numeric.english: Journey into the trenches of the Stygian Veil and kill the Stygian Lords. 4...0 of 4 still remaining.
numeric.chinese: 前往斯泰吉亚面纱的战壕并杀死斯泰吉亚领主。还剩下 4...0 个。

numeric.english: Despite the objective description, this quest does not require killing 25 foes, but requires vanquishing the area. The quest is still completed if the area is vanquished by killing less than 25 foes. See Bukdek Byway#Notes for details on 0-kill or low-count vanquishes.
numeric.chinese: 尽管有客观描述，但该任务并不需要杀死 25 个敌人，而是需要征服该地区。如果该地区因杀死少于 25 名敌人而被征服，任务仍然完成。有关零杀或低计数征服的详细信息，请参阅 Bukdek Byway#Notes。

numeric.english: Assuming you identify and sell all drops, players can expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.
numeric.chinese: 假设您找到并出售所有掉落物，玩家每次运行有望赚取 1 - 31 白金。

numeric.english: Assuming you identify and sell all drops, players can expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.
numeric.chinese: 假设您找到并出售所有掉落物，玩家每次运行有望赚取 1 - 31 白金。

numeric.english: The June 6, 2018 update made it possible for a solo player to travel to The Northlands. Killing the Oakhearts will allow for additional experience per run.
numeric.chinese: 2018 年 6 月 6 日的更新使单人玩家可以前往北地。杀死橡心队将为每次奔跑带来额外的经验。

numeric.english: Keep left on entry. The first open area will contain Ice Imps, Frost Wurms, 3 large mobs of Whirling Wisps, Frozen Elementals, Ice Imps and a Frostmaw Spawn. Frost Siege Wurms and the Frostmaw Spawn tend to popup while attacking any mob near the entrance to the level. This area leads to a path with a side hallway on left. This left hallway is a dead-end but contains an area map and a collection of Dwarven Powder Kegs. The kegs can be used to break down walls but are not necessary. When the wurms near each wall are defeated a large snowball spawns and crashes into the wall, breaking it down. The path leads to a small open area to the north which can be bypassed. To the east, the path forks north and east. The fork is guarded by 3 mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, which should be carefully sweeped and pulled. The northern path contains a number of wurm popups and leads to a Beacon of Droknar. The eastern path leads to more wurm popups and a large empty chamber to the south. The next chamber to the northeast is guarded by Ice Imps, Frozen Elementals, Whirling Wisps, more mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, as well as 2 more popup groups of Frost Wurms and Frostmaw Spawn. Careful pulling here is advised to prevent a party wipe. When the last of the wurms guarding the cracked wall blocking the exit to the 4th level is defeated, a snowball will spawn and break the wall down.
numeric.chinese: 入口处靠左行驶。第一个开放区域将包含冰小鬼、冰霜亚龙、3 个大型的旋转小精灵、冰冻元素、冰小鬼和霜喉之卵。冰霜攻城龙和霜喉之卵在攻击关卡入口附近的任何生物时往往会弹出。该区域通向一条小路，左侧有一条侧走廊。左边的走廊是一条死胡同，但包含一张区域地图和一系列矮人火药桶。小桶可以用来拆墙，但不是必需的。当每面墙附近的亚龙被击败时，一个大雪球就会生成并撞向墙，将其打破。这条路通向北面的一个小空地，可以绕过它。向东，道路向北和向东分叉。叉子由 3 个弹出的 Stormcloud Incubi 怪物守卫，应该小心地清扫和拉动它们。北面的道路包含许多亚龙弹出窗口并通向卓克纳尔信标。东边的路径通向更多的亚龙弹出窗口和南面的一个大空房间。东北方的下一个房间由冰小鬼、冰冻元素、旋转小精灵、更多弹出的暴风云梦魇小怪以及另外 2 个弹出的冰霜亚龙和霜喉之卵守卫。建议小心拉动此处，以防止派对擦拭。当守卫第四层出口的裂墙的最后一只亚龙被击败时，将会生成一个雪球并打破墙。

numeric.english: Enter Mehtani Keys and meet up with Elder Olunideh and 4 Istani Commoners. This quest is almost exactly the same as the previous quest, but there are about 30 enemies instead of 10, separated into two groups of about 15 corsairs apiece. These groups can, with a bit of luck, be separated further into groups of four or five. Take out both groups and see Elder Olunideh for your reward.
numeric.chinese: 进入 Mehtani Keys 并与 Olunideh 长老和 4 名 Istani 平民会面。这个任务和之前的任务几乎一模一样，但是敌人数量从 10 个增加到 30 个左右，分成两组，每组大约 15 只海盗。如果运气好的话，这些小组可以进一步分成四人或五人一组。干掉两组人，去见奥鲁尼德长老，领取奖励。

numeric.english: Corsair Commanders will give 5 seconds less time bonus for every 2 cycles.
numeric.chinese: 海盗船指挥官每 2 个周期将减少 5 秒的时间奖励。

numeric.english: The southern end of level 3 contains a switch that opens a secret door on the east side of the map. Inside are four Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost.
numeric.chinese: 第三层的南端有一个开关，可以打开地图东侧的一扇秘密门。里面有四个隐藏宝藏和一个矮人幽灵。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on May 10, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 5 月 10 日。

numeric.english: Stage 1
numeric.chinese: 第一阶段

numeric.english: Stage 2
numeric.chinese: 第二阶段

numeric.english: Stage 3
numeric.chinese: 第三阶段

numeric.english: Party-wide heals are very helpful in countering the AoE damage from the bit golems and protecting Bokka during phase 1. Party-wide damage reduction is also useful for this, especially Union or Shelter.
numeric.chinese: 全党范围的治疗对于对抗比特魔像的 AoE 伤害并在第一阶段保护博卡非常有帮助。全党范围的伤害减少对此也很有用，尤其是联盟或庇护所。

numeric.english: Destroy the Reaper Slayer before it reaches the mountain top.
numeric.chinese:
在死神杀手到达山顶之前将其消灭。

MAPPINGOUT_2555cdbf2a0f5a8_0
返回双蛇山收割者那里领取奖励。

numeric.english: If arriving from Ascalon Foothills, take note that sometimes a group of hydra (4 or 5) will spawn at that exit a few minutes after the map has loaded. If this happens and they were not intercepted, they will run all way to the Flame Temple Corridor exit, passing by in front of Grendich Courthouse. Upon arrival, they have been reported to either patrol (possibly as 2 groups) to and from the exits, or linger at the Flame Temple Corridor exit.
numeric.chinese: 如果从阿斯卡隆山麓抵达，请注意，有时地图加载几分钟后，该出口处会出现一群九头蛇（4 或 5 只）。如果发生这种情况，并且没有被拦截，他们会一路跑到火焰神殿走廊出口，经过格伦迪奇法院前。据报道，抵达后，他们要么在出口之间巡逻（可能分成两组），要么在火焰神殿走廊出口处徘徊。

numeric.english: It thus may be easier to take any fast rate of damage; if three hits are dealt every 2 seconds — one to trigger Life Sheath, one to redo what was healed, one to damage, then he will die eventually.
numeric.chinese: 因此，可能更容易承受任何快速的伤害；如果每2秒发出3次攻击——一击触发生命鞘，一击重做治疗，一击造成伤害，那么他最终会死。

numeric.english: Vanquishing: 117–205 foes. Has hidden Devourers.
numeric.chinese:

numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 5 月 13 日

numeric.english: Explore the area outside the Citadel and kill any remaining heket. [6...0] of 6 heket groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 探索城堡外的区域并杀死剩余的赫克特。 6 个 heket 组中的 [6...0] 仍然存在。

numeric.english: Kurzick Supply Lines (Adds 8 hidden groups of six Luxons; although, they will sometimes spawn even if the quest is not in your Quest Log.)
numeric.chinese: Kurzick 补给线（添加 8 个隐藏组，每组 6 个 Luxons；不过，即使任务不在您的任务日志中，它们有时也会生成。）

numeric.english: Scouting Ferndale (Adds 4 groups of six Luxons.)
numeric.chinese: 侦察芬代尔（添加 4 组，每组 6 名 Luxons。）

numeric.english: The opponent for the final round, or round 6, is usually Magni the Bison. Rarely, Palawa Joko with two Minions of Joko may appear instead of Magni. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
numeric.chinese: 最后一轮或第六轮的对手通常是野牛麦格尼。极少数情况下，帕拉瓦·约科和两个约科小黄人可能会代替麦格尼出现。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

numeric.english: Your character must have the quest Round 1: Fight! in order to enter the tournament. Obtain the quest from Magni the Bison if this is the first time your character is entering the tournament or is re-entering the tournament after previously winning the tournament. Losing the tournament will keep that quest in your quest log. Talk to Gellir Frostshield to start the tournament. A fee of 100gold is automatically deducted from your character upon confirmation.
numeric.chinese: 你的角色必须有任务第一轮：战斗！为了进入比赛。如果这是您的角色第一次参加锦标赛或在之前赢得锦标赛后重新参加锦标赛，请从野牛麦格尼那里获得任务。输掉比赛将会将该任务保留在您的任务日志中。与盖里尔·霜盾交谈以开始锦标赛。确认后，系统会自动从您的角色中扣除 100gold 的费用。

numeric.english: Winning the first five rounds award Norn reputation points to characters with a Norn rank of less than eight: 5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25 (for a total of 75 points).
numeric.chinese: 赢得前五轮比赛会给诺恩等级低于 8 的角色奖励诺恩声望点：5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25（总共 75 点）。

numeric.english: Destroy the binding guardians and free Razah. [3...0] of 3 guardians remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭束缚的守护者并释放拉扎。 3 名守护者中的 [3...0] 仍然存在。

numeric.english: Destroy the Charr forces to prevent the ritual from being completed. You have [3…0] groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 摧毁夏尔军队以阻止仪式完成。您还剩下 [3…0] 组。

numeric.english: Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during Charr in the Tunnels, but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some Shard Elementals, unless the nearby Ironheart has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the Elemental Crystal bundle they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.
numeric.chinese: 再次，您需要从该层的南侧走到北侧。潜行或战斗穿过大中庭到达楼梯和北部隧道；靠近东侧可能是最容易的。你的任务标记将指向你在隧道查尔期间发现北方巡逻队的水晶门，但你实际上需要先去找到东北巡逻队的地方（在右侧地图上的感叹号处）。在最东北的隧道中，你需要杀死一些碎片元素，除非附近的铁心已经帮你解决了。捡起他们掉落的元素水晶包，然后将其向西带到水晶门。当你接近大门时，水晶会消失，大门会打开，露出第三层的入口。

numeric.english: The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.
numeric.chinese: 元素系 Boss 战斗了 3 次。前两次他的生命值达到 10% 时，他会变得友好、嘲讽队伍、召唤一大群碎片元素并传送到竞技场的一侧。他的新位置将被锁在水晶门后面。要打开它，你必须杀死碎片元素，拿起其中一个携带的元素钥匙石，并将其带到水晶门。

numeric.english: Clear out the frogmen. You have [3...0] of 3 groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 清除蛙人。您还剩下 3 个组中的 [3...0] 个。

numeric.english: Use experience scrolls to reduce the number of times you need to complete the quest. (You need just under 1.2 million experience to go from L20's 140,600 xp the 1,337,500 xp for Legendary Survivor .) Repeating this in normal mode requires about 140 visits, since each run earns about 8,468 experience without scrolls.
numeric.chinese: 使用经验卷轴可以减少完成任务所需的次数。 （从 L20 的 140,600 xp 到传奇幸存者的 1,337,500 xp，你需要不到 120 万经验。） 在正常模式下重复此操作需要大约 140 次访问，因为每次运行无需卷轴即可获得大约 8,468 经验。

numeric.english: This quest is a reasonable way to earn money quickly: assuming you identify and sell everything, you should expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.
numeric.chinese: 这个任务是一种快速赚钱的合理方式：假设你识别并出售所有东西，你应该期望每次运行能赚取 1 - 31 白金。

numeric.english: Keep left on entry. The first open area will contain Ice Imps, Frost Wurms, 3 large mobs of Whirling Wisps, Frozen Elementals, Ice Imps and a Frostmaw Spawn. Frost Siege Wurms and the Frostmaw Spawn tend to popup while attacking any mob near the entrance to the level. This area leads to a path with a side hallway on left. This left hallway is a dead-end but contains an area map and a collection of Dwarven Powder Kegs. The kegs can be used to break down walls but are not necessary. When the wurms near each wall are defeated a large snowball spawns and crashes into the wall, breaking it down. The path leads to a small open area to the north which can be bypassed. To the east, the path forks north and east. The fork is guarded by 3 mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, which should be carefully sweeped and pulled. The northern path contains a number of wurm popups and leads to a Beacon of Droknar. The eastern path leads to more wurm popups and a large empty chamber to the south. The next chamber to the northeast is guarded by Ice Imps, Frozen Elementals, Whirling Wisps, more mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, as well as 2 more popup groups of Frost Wurms and Frostmaw Spawn. Careful pulling here is advised to prevent a party wipe. When the last of the wurms guarding the cracked wall blocking the exit to the 4th level is defeated, a snowball will spawn and break the wall down.
numeric.chinese: 入口处靠左行驶。第一个开放区域将包含冰小鬼、冰霜亚龙、3 个大型的旋转小精灵、冰冻元素、冰小鬼和霜喉之卵。冰霜攻城龙和霜喉之卵在攻击关卡入口附近的任何生物时往往会弹出。该区域通向一条小路，左侧有一条侧走廊。左边的走廊是一条死胡同，但包含一张区域地图和一系列矮人火药桶。小桶可以用来拆墙，但不是必需的。当每面墙附近的亚龙被击败时，一个大雪球就会生成并撞向墙，将其打破。这条路通向北面的一个小空地，可以绕过它。向东，道路向北和向东分叉。叉子由 3 个弹出的 Stormcloud Incubi 怪物守卫，应该小心地清扫和拉动它们。北面的道路包含许多亚龙弹出窗口并通向卓克纳尔信标。东边的路径通向更多的亚龙弹出窗口和南面的一个大空房间。东北方的下一个房间由冰小鬼、冰冻元素、旋转小精灵、更多弹出的暴风云梦魇小怪以及另外 2 个弹出的冰霜亚龙和霜喉之卵守卫。建议小心拉动此处，以防止派对擦拭。当守卫第四层出口的裂墙的最后一只亚龙被击败时，将会生成一个雪球并打破墙。

numeric.english: Meet up with Library Envoy Chukeht (4) in the Hidden City, and follow the quest pointer to each of the djinn lords (1) and (2). After doing this, head to the large open area where the altars are (3). It is a very good idea to clear this area of djinn before activating both Altar of Water and Altar of Fire, since even more djinn will spawn when you do. After placing the essences on the altars (i.e. touching both), you must flee back to the entry portal of the Hidden City; do not map out, as this will leave the quest unfinished. Instead, wait for Chukeht to arrive at the entrance. Once he slowly walks towards the exit, the quest will update. If he does not start moving by himself, consider moving slightly closer to the exit portal than the quest marker indicates.
numeric.chinese: 在隐秘之城与图书馆特使楚克特 (Chukeht) 会面，然后按照任务指针找到每位巨灵领主 (1) 和 (2)。完成此操作后，前往祭坛所在的大片开放区域 (3)。在激活水祭坛和火祭坛之前清除该区域的巨灵是一个非常好的主意，因为当你这样做时会产生更多的巨灵。将精华放在祭坛上（即触摸两者）后，您必须逃回隐秘之城的入口；不要绘制地图，因为这将使任务未完成。相反，请等待 Chukeht 到达入口处。一旦他慢慢走向出口，任务就会更新。如果他没有开始自行移动，请考虑移动到比任务标记指示的稍微靠近出口的地方。

numeric.english: Each party member will be awarded 6000 Delver Reputation points should they break the quarterly record (3 months).
numeric.chinese: 如果每位党员打破季度记录（3 个月），他们将获得 6000 Delver 声望点。

numeric.english: In either case, follow the quest pointer and make your way towards the missing patrol's last known position. Unfortunately, few members of the patrol remain; they have no doubt been slain by the heket in the area. However, the captain and 2 guards are still alive and being held prisoner, so the party must make haste to the next point and rescue them from the roaming creatures!
numeric.chinese: 无论哪种情况，请按照任务指针前往失踪巡逻队最后已知的位置。不幸的是，巡逻队成员所剩无几。毫无疑问，他们是被该地区的赫克特杀死的。然而，队长和两名守卫仍然活着并被囚禁，所以队伍必须赶紧前往下一个地点，从漫游的生物手中救出他们！

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 4 月 25 日。

numeric.english: On level 2 there are a total of five Dwarven Ghosts, even though the level has fewer than 30 enemies.
numeric.chinese: 在第 2 层，尽管该层的敌人数量少于 30 个，但总共有 5 个矮人幽灵。

numeric.english: 1 Branch of Juni Berries for every 5 enemies eaten
numeric.chinese: 每吃掉 5 个敌人即可获得 1 枝朱尼浆果

numeric.chinese: 如果使用幸存者角色，请在结束前提防 Boss - 在保护 AL 40 目标之前，他可以击中超过 150 次。
