numeric.english: Though the foes you face are random, research shows that there appears to be a list of foes which may occur each round (for example, the 6th round seems to be a Heket most of the time).
numeric.chinese: 虽然你面对的敌人是随机的，但研究表明，似乎每轮都可能出现一个敌人列表（例如，第六轮大多数时候似乎是 Heket）。

numeric.english: Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.
numeric.chinese: 科谢克的队伍中包括数名咆哮以太者和至少一名巨灵。还有多达三个卫星群，每个卫星群由更多的巨灵和咆哮以太组成。在困难模式下，红宝石巨灵可以使用液体火焰进行非常猛烈的攻击（超过 200 点伤害），而科谢克则可以使用灼热火焰对 60 个护甲等级角色造成超过 250 点伤害。这意味着，即使没有死亡惩罚，整个队伍也可以在两到三击中被消灭，因为这些都是 AoE 攻击。考虑从提哈克果园外的梅兰德鲁守望者那里获得护盾树枝的祝福，以减少科谢克和红宝石巨灵造成的伤害。

numeric.english: Kill the Cursed Brigand to the immediate left of the portal. When it dies, a chest spawns with an unlit torch, which you will need for most of this level. Take down the mob that blocks the way to a lit brazier and then light all the flame braziers in the circular graveyard room. Be ready for a large mob of undead and enchanted that spawn in a random spot within the room after the final one ignites; they must be killed before the exit door will open for you. Next, make your way to the tiled room to light the 2 of 4 unlit flame braziers, spawning yet another mob including a Cursed Brigand. Kill the Brigand to get the dungeon key to exit the level (he can be pulled away from his group). Leave the torch behind and head for the exit to the next level.
numeric.chinese: 杀死传送门左侧的被诅咒的强盗。当它死亡时，会生成一个带有未点燃的火把的箱子，这是您在本关卡的大部分时间都需要的。消灭阻挡通往点燃火盆的道路的怪物，然后点燃圆形墓地房间中的所有火焰火盆。准备好迎接一大群不死生物和附魔生物，它们会在最后一个被点燃后在房间内的随机位置产生；必须在出口门为你打开之前杀死他们。接下来，前往铺有瓷砖的房间，点燃 4 个未点燃的火盆中的 2 个，从而产生包括诅咒强盗在内的另一只生物。杀死强盗以获得退出关卡的地牢钥匙（可以将他从他的队伍中拉开）。留下火把，前往下一层的出口。

numeric.english: Lighting all braziers in the southwest room on 3rd level (where you get the last key) opens a secret passage near the very beginning of the 3rd level (Northeast corner of the map). Consider running back to that secret area to collect hidden treasures.
numeric.chinese: 点燃第三层西南房间的所有火盆（在那里你可以获得最后一把钥匙）会在第三层的最开始处（地图的东北角）打开一条秘密通道。考虑跑回那个秘密区域收集隐藏的宝藏。

numeric.english: Help Pelei by slaying 10 Killer Iboga. You have slain [0...10] of 10 Killer Iboga.
numeric.chinese: 帮助佩雷杀死 10 名杀手伊博加。您已杀死 10 名杀手伊博加中的 [0...10] 名。

numeric.english: You have collected Message: Year 2
numeric.chinese: 您已收集消息：第二年

numeric.english: Maishang Hills (Year 2) - This bottle is just outside the Gyala Hatchery (outpost), step carefully and avoid the Kappa patrols.
numeric.chinese: 麦尚山（第二年）-这个瓶子就在嘉拉孵化场（前哨站）外面，小心行走并避开河童巡逻队。

numeric.english: For faster and more efficient skill capping, do not go to the closest group. Head north/northeast to where there are 3 Avicara spawns. There you will have 3 of the 6 possible bosses, and thus a greater chance to find the one you need. You may also go to the nearest spawn and hold the hotkey to highlight enemies to check if the boss is there. If it is not, just run back to Tasca's Demise and back to Mineral Springs. Remember not to resign or you'll have to cross Tasca's Demise again.
numeric.chinese: 为了更快、更有效地限制技能，不要去最近的小组。向北/东北方向前往有 3 个 Avicara 生成点的地方。在那里你将拥有 6 个可能的 Boss 中的 3 个，因此更有机会找到你需要的那个。您也可以前往最近的重生点并按住热键突出显示敌人以检查 Boss 是否在那里。如果不是，就跑回塔斯卡的灭亡并返回矿泉。记住不要辞职，否则你将不得不再次穿越塔斯卡的灭亡。

numeric.english: As soon as you enter the zone, head towards Xin Ji to trigger the initial dialogue. Once that ends, start moving towards each successive quest marker; these lead you through the most efficient escape route. If you start right away, you can evade the ministry troops even after they start following you. Along the way, reinforcements will spawn, but as long as you keep moving, you will be able to lead Xin Ji to safety.
numeric.chinese:
进入区域后，前往辛吉，触发初始对话。一旦结束，开始朝每个连续的任务标记移动；这些将引导您通过最有效的逃生路线。如果你立即开始，即使部委部队开始跟踪你，你也可以躲避他们。一路上会出现援军，但只要你继续前进，就能带领辛霁安全抵达安全地带。

numeric.chinese: 1 赢得 90 分。一场比赛持续 5 分钟。

numeric.english: A good opening piece when you still need to use common pieces is the Skale because it does 150 damage with its spammable attack to enemies > 50% health and has two damage skills, both of which do a great deal of damage but take time to activate and thus benefit from facing a healthy opponent.
numeric.chinese: 当你仍然需要使用普通棋子时，一个很好的开局棋子是斯卡勒，因为它对生命值 > 50% 的敌人进行垃圾邮件攻击，造成 150 点伤害，并且有两种伤害技能，这两种技能都会造成大量伤害，但需要时间来激活，因此从面对健康的对手时受益。

numeric.english: Each leader will be accompanied by 3 other skree harpies, usually Trackers and Raiders. After defeating each leader's group, a 2nd group of skree will pop up and attempt to run away, towards the portal with Resplendent Makuun (without attacking the party); chasing them down or letting them run away does not affect the quest.
numeric.chinese: 每个领导者都会有 3 个其他斯克雷鹰身女妖陪同，通常是追踪者和掠夺者。击败每个首领的队伍后，第二组斯克雷会突然出现并试图逃跑，与辉煌的马库恩一起逃向传送门（不攻击队伍）；追赶他们或让他们逃跑并不影响任务。

numeric.english: Alert the scholars about the assault on the Halls of Chokhin. You have spoken to 0...8 of 8 scholars.
numeric.chinese: 向学者们通报乔欣大厅遭到的袭击。您已与 8 位学者中的 0...8 位进行过交谈。

numeric.english: Protect the scholars from the advancing Margonite forces. At least 4 scholars must survive. 8...0 of 8 scholars are still alive.
numeric.chinese: 保护学者们免受玛贡尼特势力的侵害。至少有 4 名学者必须幸存。 8 名学者中有 8...0 人还活着。

numeric.english: Eliminate the groups of Margonites attacking Chokhin. 12...0 of 12 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭攻击乔欣的玛贡派团体。 12 组中的 12...0 剩余。

numeric.english: Even with this careful approach, you will likely find that the Margonites attack in waves of 3 groups (so 2 waves on each of the north and south sides to make the total 12 groups). Do note that there are 4 different kinds of groups. The first group at the east are mostly rangers. The 2nd at the east side are melee. The 2 groups on the west side are both casters and melee.
numeric.chinese: 即使采用这种谨慎的方法，您也可能会发现玛贡尼特人会以 3 组为一组进行攻击（因此南北两侧各各 2 波，总共 12 组）。请注意，有 4 种不同类型的组。东部的第一组主要是护林员。东侧第二场是混战。西侧2组都是法师和近战。

numeric.english: Visit gravesites and help Hareh summon the undead. You have visited 0 of 5 gravesites.
numeric.chinese: 参观墓地并帮助 Hareh 召唤亡灵。您已参观过 5 个墓地中的 0 个。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on April 26, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 4 月 26 日。

numeric.english: Enter Issnur Isles from Kodlonu Hamlet and follow the quest marker to find Rojis. He will ask you to kill five level 11 Mandragors located to the south-west of Rojis' position, in the midst of several groups of skale. When you have killed all five mandragors, speak to Rojis again, and then return to Castellan Puuba.
numeric.chinese: 从科德洛努哈姆雷特进入伊斯努尔群岛，然后按照任务标记找到罗吉斯。他会要求你杀死位于罗吉斯阵地西南方向、几组斯卡莱中间的 5 只 11 级曼德拉角兽。当你杀死所有五个曼德拉草后，再次与罗吉斯交谈，然后返回卡斯特兰普乌巴。

numeric.english: Kill the demons infesting the Sebelkeh Basilica. 7...0 of 7 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消灭侵扰塞贝尔克大教堂的恶魔。 7 组中的 7...0 组剩余。

numeric.english: The best method for gaining points is seeking and killing Lost Souls. Kill the first few Maddened Spirits until you have unlocked two areas. Then, start running in your wurm through the areas. There are three spawn points in the northwestern corner (one on rocky ground), three in the northeastern corner, one in the southeastern corner (on rocky ground) and two in the southwestern corner. When you start running, go through each area methodically, scanning for lost souls. Do not fight the Spirits. Let them chase you and use your tunnel skill to keep ahead of them. When you find a lost soul, make sure you have some space between you and the spirits before you kill it. Then, tunnel quickly away. This will take a while, but done effectively you can rack up many points.
numeric.chinese: 获得积分的最佳方法是寻找并杀死失落的灵魂。杀死前几个疯狂的灵魂，直到你解锁两个区域。然后，开始在你的亚龙中奔跑穿过这些区域。西北角有 3 个生成点（1 个在岩石地面上），东北角有 3 个，东南角有 1 个（岩石地面），西南角有 2 个。当你开始跑步时，有条不紊地穿过每个区域，寻找迷失的灵魂。不要与灵魂对抗。让他们追你，并利用你的隧道技巧保持领先。当你发现一个迷失的灵魂时，在杀死它之前确保你和灵魂之间有一些距离。然后，快速地隧道离开。这将需要一段时间，但如果做得有效，您可以获得很多积分。

numeric.english: While this quest is active, Devona will follow you wherever you go in Pockmark Flats, and can be used as a 4th henchman in the area.
numeric.chinese: 当这个任务活跃时，无论你去波克马克平原，德沃娜都会跟着你，并且可以作为该地区的第四个追随者。

numeric.english: Six waves of enemies will then attack alternating sides of the village: waves 1 and 3 come from the Nebo side; waves 2 and 4 come from the Watchtower side; and waves 5 and 6 come nearly simultaneously from both sides. Avoid the front lines, so that you can cover as many villagers as possible with Keiran's shout and stance. Use interrupts frequently, and watch out for minion-producing necromancers that hide outside the village.
numeric.chinese: 然后，六波敌人将交替攻击村庄的两侧：第一波和第三波来自尼波一侧；第2波和第4波来自了望塔一侧；第5波和第6波几乎同时从两侧袭来。避开前线，这样你就可以用凯兰的喊声和姿态覆盖尽可能多的村民。经常使用打断，并提防隐藏在村外的生产小兵的死灵法师。

numeric.english: This quest appears to have been added after the November 30th, 2006 update.
numeric.chinese: 该任务似乎是在 2006 年 11 月 30 日更新后添加的。

numeric.english: This quest is automatically completed upon defeating the round 1 opponent. The follow-up quest Round 2: Fight! is automatically accepted (that is, if you win round 1.)
numeric.chinese: 该任务在击败第一轮对手后自动完成。后续任务第二轮：战斗！自动接受（即，如果您赢得第一轮。）

numeric.english: Your character must have the quest Round 1: Fight! in order to enter the tournament. Obtain the quest from Magni the Bison if this is the first time your character is entering the tournament or is re-entering the tournament after previously winning the tournament. Losing the tournament will keep that quest in your quest log. Talk to Gellir Frostshield to start the tournament. A fee of 100gold is automatically deducted from your character upon confirmation.
numeric.chinese: 你的角色必须有任务第一轮：战斗！为了进入比赛。如果这是您的角色第一次参加锦标赛或在之前赢得锦标赛后重新参加锦标赛，请从野牛麦格尼那里获得任务。输掉比赛将会将该任务保留在您的任务日志中。与盖里尔·霜盾交谈以开始锦标赛。确认后，系统会自动从您的角色中扣除 100gold 的费用。

numeric.english: Winning the first five rounds award Norn reputation points to characters with a Norn rank of less than eight: 5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25 (for a total of 75 points).
numeric.chinese: 赢得前五轮比赛会给诺恩等级低于 8 的角色奖励诺恩声望点：5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25（总共 75 点）。

numeric.english: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 1 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 2 opponent and the follow-up quest Round 3: Fight! is automatically accepted.
numeric.chinese: 完成前一个任务（即赢得锦标赛第一轮）后，该任务将自动接受。击败第二轮对手和后续任务第三轮：战斗后也会自动完成。会自动接受。

numeric.english: On the first level, near the door to Level 2, beware of the popup Ooze group. Try to pull the Charr away from that spot to avoid being overwhelmed.
numeric.chinese: 在第一层，靠近第二层的门处，小心弹出的软泥怪组。尝试将夏尔拉离该位置，以免被淹没。

numeric.english: Originally, the Battle Axe (hatchet) that is given as reward in this mission, had different upgrades, allowing to put two grips at the same time. Doing this, for example, combinations of two Axe Grips of Enchanting were possible, providing a permanent +40% longevity in enchantments. This was modified in the December 20, 2005 game update and all the axes inside the game were forcibly changed to the current one (including the ones inside the inventory backpack).
numeric.chinese: 最初，在这个任务中作为奖励给出的战斧（斧头）有不同的升级，允许同时放置两个握把。例如，这样做可以组合两个附魔斧握，提供永久+40%的附魔寿命。这在2005年12月20日的游戏更新中进行了修改，游戏内的所有轴都被强制更改为当前的轴（包括库存背包内的轴）。

numeric.english: This quest was used often for FFF prior to the November 13th 2008 update
numeric.chinese: 在 2008 年 11 月 13 日更新之前，此任务经常用于 FFF

numeric.english: This quest was used for Kurzick fast faction farming prior to the November 13th 2008 update, which added the requirement of killing the Luxon spawns (and moved the 4 spawn locations), significantly increasing the time required to complete the quest.
numeric.chinese: 此任务在 2008 年 11 月 13 日更新之前用于库尔兹克快速派系耕作，更新增加了杀死 Luxon 生成点的要求（并移动了 4 个生成位置），显着增加了完成任务所需的时间。

numeric.english: Help train the service staff by leading them into combat. Destroy 20 practice dummies in 3 minutes.
numeric.chinese: 通过引导服务人员参加战斗来帮助培训他们。在 3 分钟内摧毁 20 个练习假人。

numeric.english: If you have rearranged your skills so that your 7th skill slot is taken, "Find Their Weakness!" will replace the skill on this slot.
numeric.chinese: 如果你重新安排了你的技能，以便你的第七个技能槽被占用，“找到他们的弱点！”将取代该槽位上的技能。

numeric.english: Kill the Cursed Brigand to the immediate left of the portal. When it dies, a chest spawns with an unlit torch, which you will need for most of this level. Take down the mob that blocks the way to a lit brazier and then light all the flame braziers in the circular graveyard room. Be ready for a large mob of undead and enchanted that spawn in a random spot within the room after the final one ignites; they must be killed before the exit door will open for you. Next, make your way to the tiled room to light the 2 of 4 unlit flame braziers, spawning yet another mob including a Cursed Brigand. Kill the Brigand to get the dungeon key to exit the level (he can be pulled away from his group). Leave the torch behind and head for the exit to the next level.
numeric.chinese: 杀死传送门左侧的被诅咒的强盗。当它死亡时，会生成一个带有未点燃的火把的箱子，这是您在本关卡的大部分时间都需要的。消灭阻挡通往点燃火盆的道路的怪物，然后点燃圆形墓地房间中的所有火焰火盆。准备好迎接一大群不死生物和附魔生物，它们会在最后一个被点燃后在房间内的随机位置产生；必须在出口门为你打开之前杀死他们。接下来，前往铺有瓷砖的房间，点燃 4 个未点燃的火盆中的 2 个，从而产生包括诅咒强盗在内的另一只生物。杀死强盗以获得退出关卡的地牢钥匙（可以将他从他的队伍中拉开）。留下火把，前往下一层的出口。

numeric.english: Lighting all braziers in the southwest room on 3rd level (where you get the last key) opens a secret passage near the very beginning of the 3rd level (Northeast corner of the map). Consider running back to that secret area to collect hidden treasures.
numeric.chinese: 点燃第三层西南房间的所有火盆（在那里你可以获得最后一把钥匙）会在第三层的最开始处（地图的东北角）打开一条秘密通道。考虑跑回那个秘密区域收集隐藏的宝藏。

numeric.english: Because so many groups kill each other, it is possible to complete the vanquish by killing only around 175 enemies, despite there being over 240.
numeric.chinese: 由于如此多的团体互相残杀，尽管敌人数量超过 240 人，但只需杀死约 175 人就可以完成征服。

numeric.english: Find the skree harpy nests on the Cliffs of Dohjok and destroy the skree hatchlings. You have destroyed [0...26] of 26 hatchlings so far.
numeric.chinese: 找到多赫约克悬崖上的斯克雷鹰身女妖巢穴并消灭斯克雷幼体。到目前为止，您已消灭了 26 只幼体中的 [0...26] 只。

numeric.english: You start in a random location in Dragon's Gullet. Charr patrols travel around the southernmost tar lake. There is a single Siege Devourer to the north, 2 more to the east, a large group of low-level Charr to the southwest and a group containing a single Charr Lord is to the north. After killing all 100 Charr, your party will be transported to Longeye's Ledge.
numeric.chinese: 你从龙之食道的随机位置开始。夏尔巡逻队在最南端的焦油湖周围巡逻。北边有一个攻城吞噬者，东边还有两个，西南方向有一大群低级夏尔，北边有一个包含一个夏尔领主的群体。杀死全部 100 名夏尔后，你的队伍将被传送至长眼壁架。

numeric.english: The 8 Ascalonian soldiers are positioned with four soldiers inside the courthouse, two at the top of the steps to the courthouse, and two at the bottom of the steps.
numeric.chinese: 8 名阿斯卡隆士兵被安置在法院大楼内，其中 4 名士兵位于法院大楼的台阶顶部，另外两名位于台阶底部。

numeric.english: You have eliminated [0...5] of the 5 peddlers.
numeric.chinese: 您已经消灭了 5 个小贩中的 [0...5] 个。

numeric.english: Tydus's Tips (5th edition)
numeric.chinese: 泰达斯的秘诀（第五版）

numeric.english: Captain Greywind will not spawn if you have the Wintersday quest A Very Grentchie Wintersday task "Travel to the Ascalon Settlement with the Grentch and destroy all the Wintersday gifts from Dwayna. 0 of 7 Wintersday gifts remaining." active.
numeric.chinese: 如果你有冬日任务 一个非常格伦奇的冬日任务“与格伦奇一起前往阿斯卡隆定居点并销毁来自德薇娜的所有冬日礼物。剩余 7 个冬日礼物中的 0 个”，灰风船长将不会生成。积极的。

numeric.english: Defeat Rend Ragemauler's guards. You have killed [0..9] of 9 guards.
numeric.chinese: 击败雷德·暴虐者的守卫。你已经杀死了 9 名守卫中的 [0..9] 名。

numeric.english: This is the arrival room. The party must split into four groups of three. Each group needs to enter through one of four different portals, which will activate from the far right to the far left one at a time. Ideally each group of 3 should possess a knockdown. The team should have decided upon the group split prior to entering the mission - do not linger in this section, characters will quickly be overcast. When organizing groups ensure to assign characters equally e.g.: two damage dealers and one monk. As long as one of the four teams breaks out into the 5th section and kills the Aspect of Pain, they can then rescue the whole team through the now open gates. It is not necessary to kill any of the first four Aspects as killing the fish in each room will open the gates regardless of the status of the Aspects.
numeric.chinese: 这是到达房间。该党必须分成四组，每组三人。每个小组需要通过四个不同的门户之一进入，这些门户将从最右到最左一次激活。理想情况下，每组 3 人都应具有击倒能力。团队应该在进入任务之前就决定好分组——不要在这个部分徘徊，角色很快就会阴沉的。组织团体时，确保平等分配角色，例如：两名伤害经销商和一名僧侣。只要四支队伍中的一支突入第五区，击杀痛苦之象，就可以通过现在打开的大门营救全队。没有必要杀死前四个守护者中的任何一个，因为无论守护者的状态如何，杀死每个房间中的鱼都会打开大门。

numeric.english: Aspect of Depletion : While under this aspect, every 30 seconds, you lose 10 Energy and take 8 points of damage for every point of Energy lost this way.
numeric.chinese: 消耗方面：在此方面下，每30秒，你会失去10点能量，并且每损失1点能量就会受到8点伤害。

numeric.english: A snaking corridor awaits ahead, turning the first corner will trigger the charge of seven waves of Oni & Nightmares that spawn on the path behind. (Occasionally a chest will spawn with the foes.) The party will also be under fire from flowers that can be deactivated by touching them just like in the 6th section. There are two distinct methods to deal with the waves of foes:
numeric.chinese: 前方有一条蜿蜒的走廊，转弯第一个拐角将触发后面道路上产生的七波鬼与梦魇的冲锋。 （有时敌人会生成一个箱子。）队伍也会受到花朵的攻击，就像第六部分一样，可以通过触摸花朵来关闭花朵。有两种不同的方法来应对敌人的浪潮：

numeric.english: Aspect of Torment : While under this aspect, you take 50 damage every 3 seconds if you don't use a skill.
numeric.chinese: 折磨方面：在此方面下，如果你不使用技能，你每3秒会受到50点伤害。

numeric.english: Kanaxai is a difficult foe, as he hits very hard and very fast. Each successful hit also knocks his target down. He uses an enchantment called Nightmare Refuge (1-second cast time, 10-second recharge), which makes all spells fail 50% of the time, and gives him a 50% chance to block attacks. In addition, that enchantment also heals him for 1,000 health if it is not removed within the 10 seconds it lasts. And finally, like all of the Aspects of Kanaxai, he stops taking damage at 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20% of his maximum health. To resume normal damage, a knockdown is necessary (although life stealing skills continue to function). The difference between Kanaxai and his aspects are that each of Kanaxai's knockdowns will spawn a mob of twelve creatures:
numeric.chinese: Kanaxai 是一个很难对付的敌人，因为他的打击非常猛烈且速度非常快。每一次成功的命中也会击倒他的目标。他使用了一种名为“噩梦避难所”的结界（1秒施法时间，10秒充能），这使得所有法术有50%的几率失败，并让他有50%的几率格挡攻击。此外，如果在持续 10 秒内没有将其移除，该结界还会治愈他 1,000 点生命值。最后，像所有 Kanaxai 守护者一样，他在最大生命值的 80%、60%、40% 和 20% 时不再受到伤害。要恢复正常伤害，需要击倒（尽管生命窃取技能仍然有效）。 Kanaxai 和他的方面之间的区别在于 Kanaxai 的每次击倒都会产生十二个生物的暴徒：

numeric.english: You can trigger Varny's initial dialogue and the spawning of the manipulated grawl from the ledge above, near the 2nd resurrection shrine:
numeric.chinese: 你可以触发 Varny 的初始对话，并从上方靠近第二个复活神殿的壁架上生成受操纵的穴居人：

numeric.english: Chamber 1: The first group are Margonites; when they are destroyed, they spawn a group of two Despair Titans and two Rage Titans.
numeric.chinese: 第一室：第一组是玛贡派；当它们被摧毁时，它们会产生一组两个绝望泰坦和两个愤怒泰坦。

numeric.english: Strategy 1: Defend the Reaper
numeric.chinese: 策略一：保卫收割者

numeric.english: An efficient team can complete the quest in under three minutes (including travel time). With the Blessing of the Luxons active, you can earn 140-160 points, in addition to the 400 point reward for completing the quest. This translates to roughly 11,000 points per hour.
numeric.chinese: 一个高效的团队可以在三分钟内完成任务（包括行程时间）。激活卢克森祝福后，除了完成任务的 400 点奖励之外，您还可以获得 140-160 点。这相当于每小时大约 11,000 点。

numeric.english: Ideally, come from the south, keeping east of Adelbern's trigger circle. Kill the eastern-most group first. Work your way counter-clockwise for groups 2 and 3. For the last of the northern groups, use only one hero to pull them closer to you by carefully flagging the hero, while keeping the rest of your party back with you. As soon as the hero gets attacked, pull them back to you. If the hero should die, use another hero to ressurect them. Finally, backtrack towards the 5th and last group to the crossroad. Careful pulling should also be used for enemies between you and the last group.
numeric.chinese: 理想情况下，从南边过来，保持在阿德尔伯恩触发圈的东边。先杀掉最东边的那群。第 2 组和第 3 组按逆时针方向进行。对于最后一组北方组，仅使用一名英雄，通过小心地标记该英雄来将他们拉近您的距离，同时让您的队伍的其他成员留在您身边。一旦英雄受到攻击，就将他们拉回到你身边。如果英雄死了，请使用另一个英雄来复活他们。最后，原路返回第五组，也是最后一组，到达十字路口。对于你和最后一组之间的敌人也应该小心拉动。

numeric.english: Roleplaying characters on accounts created prior to the January 19, 2006 update do not need to complete the Zaishen Challenge to acquire this quest.
numeric.chinese: 在 2006 年 1 月 19 日更新之前创建的帐户上的角色扮演角色不需要完成 Zaishen 挑战来获得此任务。

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

numeric.english: Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during Charr in the Tunnels, but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some Shard Elementals, unless the nearby Ironheart has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the Elemental Crystal bundle they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.
numeric.chinese: 再次，您需要从该层的南侧走到北侧。潜行或战斗穿过大中庭到达楼梯和北部隧道；靠近东侧可能是最容易的。你的任务标记将指向你在隧道查尔期间发现北方巡逻队的水晶门，但你实际上需要先去找到东北巡逻队的地方（在右侧地图上的感叹号处）。在最东北的隧道中，你需要杀死一些碎片元素，除非附近的铁心已经帮你解决了。捡起他们掉落的元素水晶包，然后将其向西带到水晶门。当你接近大门时，水晶会消失，大门会打开，露出第三层的入口。

numeric.english: The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.
numeric.chinese: 元素系 Boss 战斗了 3 次。前两次他的生命值达到 10% 时，他会变得友好、嘲讽队伍、召唤一大群碎片元素并传送到竞技场的一侧。他的新位置将被锁在水晶门后面。要打开它，你必须杀死碎片元素，拿起其中一个携带的元素钥匙石，并将其带到水晶门。

numeric.english: Search for and rescue Nightfall survivors in the ruins of the Mirror of Lyss and the surrounding area. [3...0] of 3 survivor groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 在利斯之镜及周边地区的废墟中搜寻并营救夜幕降临的幸存者。 3 个幸存者群体中的 [3...0] 仍然存在。

numeric.english: This quest is part of Hearts of the North, the second installment in Guild Wars Beyond.
numeric.chinese: 该任务是《激战3》第二部分《北方之心》的一部分。

numeric.english: Orion starts walking as soon as you get done talking to him and, unless killed along the way, ultimately returns to Foible's Fair.
numeric.chinese:
猎户座在你与他交谈完后就开始行走，除非途中被杀，否则最终会返回福布尔集市。

MAPPINGOUT_f6cea476ad309b0_0
沿着公路穿过北科瑞塔省到达尼波台地。

numeric.english: It is recommended to also complete the quest Good Demon Hunting, since it takes place near the 2nd checkpoint.
numeric.chinese: 建议同时完成任务“良好的恶魔狩猎”，因为它发生在第二个检查站附近。

references.title: They Only Come Out at Night

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 4 月 25 日。

numeric.english: Gather 20 shells on the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You have gathered [0...20] of 20.
numeric.chinese: 在 Mehtani Keys 的海滩上收集 20 个贝壳。您已收集了 20 个中的 [0...20] 个。

numeric.english: You can trigger Varny's initial dialogue and the spawning of the manipulated grawl from the ledge above, near the 2nd resurrection shrine:
numeric.chinese: 你可以触发 Varny 的初始对话，并从上方靠近第二个复活神殿的壁架上生成受操纵的穴居人：

numeric.english: Convince Kareh Ossa's commanders to align with Joko by defeating them in combat. You have defeated [0...4] of 4 commanders.
numeric.chinese: 在战斗中击败卡雷·奥萨的指挥官，说服他们与约科结盟。您已击败 4 位指挥官中的 [0...4] 位。

numeric.english: Route 1: Starting from Fort Ranik: Enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and head to the southernmost marked point on the map. If she isn't there, her three remaining possible spawn locations can be checked consecutively from that point. Note that this route has less distance to cover but many more enemies to deal with.
numeric.chinese: 路线一：从拉尼克堡出发：从拉尼克堡进入摄政谷，前往地图最南端的标记点。如果她不在那里，则可以从该点开始连续检查她剩余的三个可能的重生位置。请注意，这条路线的距离较短，但需要对付的敌人较多。

numeric.english: The holy damage caused by Utini Wupwup and the Grawl Shamans, especially from Symbol of Wrath and Banish, as well as the lack of exploitable corpses, usually makes attempts to use minions difficult if not impossible.
numeric.chinese:
乌蒂尼·乌普乌普和穴居人萨满造成的神圣伤害，尤其是来自愤怒象征和放逐的伤害，以及缺乏可利用的尸体，通常使得使用小兵的尝试变得困难，甚至不可能。

MAPPINGOUT_24e09cfb4aeec98_0
敌人的等级取决于等级最低的队员的等级：

numeric.english: This area is a popular choice for farming Norn title points. You can earn 4,000 points in Normal mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active or 450 points per 5 minute run in hard mode by just defeating the Facets. You can earn around 20,000 points in Hard mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active. See Norn farming for details.
numeric.chinese: 该区域是种植诺恩头衔点数的热门选择。在正常模式下，通过清理激活“启示之路”的区域，您可以获得 4,000 点积分；在困难模式下，只需击败小面，每跑 5 分钟即可获得 450 点积分。在困难模式中，您可以通过清理激活“启示之路”的区域来获得大约 20,000 点积分。有关详细信息，请参阅诺恩农业。

numeric.english: On the first level, near the door to Level 2, beware of the popup Ooze group. Try to pull the Charr away from that spot to avoid being overwhelmed.
numeric.chinese: 在第一层，靠近第二层的门处，小心弹出的软泥怪组。尝试将夏尔拉离该位置，以免被淹没。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on 11th May 2009
numeric.chinese: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 5 月 11 日

numeric.english: See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
numeric.chinese: 奖励见Zehchu【再神挑战】。

numeric.english: There are 2-3 hidden groups of oozes on level 2, in a low-ceilinged waterway.
numeric.chinese: 在第 2 层低矮的水道中，有 2-3 个隐藏的软泥怪群。

numeric.chinese:
街头暴力

科米尔的远征

numeric.english: The Ministry foes stand around in a large group while the dialogue takes place; consider abusing this by bringing a trapper to cover the ground under them with traps that will all trigger at once when they turn hostile, effectively wiping them out, or at least thinning their numbers.
numeric.chinese:
对话期间，魔法部的敌人们围成一大群站着；考虑滥用这一点，让一个捕兽者用陷阱覆盖他们下面的地面，当他们变得敌对时，这些陷阱会立即触发，有效地消灭他们，或者至少减少他们的数量。

MAPPINGOUT_675231becdcecfb_0
当您接受此任务时，部长法令将添加到您的库存中。

numeric.english: Enter the Undercity from the Wajjun Bazaar, via the Nahpui Quarter outpost. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the Kappa come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of spellcasters, area of effect skills and caster shutdown will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the Am Fah. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)
numeric.chinese: 从 Wajjun Bazaar 穿过 Nahpui Quarter 前哨进入幽暗城。由于 Oroku 必须生存，请在腐败区域靠近他，让河童来找你。在每个地点，河童会以 3 或 4 人为一组，从每个入口点分 4 波进行攻击。由于河童是一大群施法者，范围技能和施法者关闭将非常有帮助。 Oroku 将与队伍一起在地点之间停留，因此移动过程中唯一的危险是 Am Fah。小心这些小怪，因为很容易过度仇恨并导致任务失败。尽管耗时，但最安全的做法是在进入 Oroku 之前清理出道路（要么不从南 Wajjun Bazaar 进入，要么在他完成对话之前跑过去。）

numeric.english: Travel throughout Echovald Forest and slay 40 wardens. You have killed [0...40] of 40 wardens.
numeric.chinese: 穿越 Echovald 森林并杀死 40 名看守。您已杀死 40 名典狱长中的 [0...40] 名。

numeric.english: After you reach wave eight, each wave will afterwards consist of six Siege Turtles scattered across the map in pairs. Defeating all six in the time allotted for that wave will grant you a 50 point bonus, plus 5 points for each wave of turtles you have successfully destroyed previously. The turtles will attack from a large range, but then will be vulnerable while their attack is recharging.
numeric.chinese: 当你到达第八波后，每一波将由六只成对分散在地图上的攻城龟组成。在为该波分配的时间内击败全部 6 只海龟将为您提供 50 点奖励，此外，您之前成功消灭的每波海龟还可获得 5 点奖励。海龟会从大范围攻击，但在攻击充电时会变得脆弱。

numeric.english: Your faction cap will increase by 1,000 Luxon faction the first time you finish this mission with 100 points or more.
numeric.chinese: 当您第一次以 100 点或更多积分完成此任务时，您的派系上限将增加 1,000 Luxon 派系。

numeric.english: Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20…35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35…60 Health when this shout ends.
numeric.chinese: 喊叫。对于领导力中的每一个 2 等级，在 4 秒和 1 秒内，所有在听力范围内的队员都会受到 20…35% 更少的伤害。当喊声结束时，受影响的队员的生命值 35…60 会得到治愈。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.
numeric.chinese:
结界咒语。在 4…9…10 秒内，每当目标盟友受到近战攻击时，所有相邻敌人都会失去所有肾上腺素和 3 能量。

MAPPINGOUT_2c028ccca6cea9b_0
技能。对于 4…9…10 第二，没有任何反应。当该技能结束时，目标盟友附近的所有敌人都会受到 3 闪电伤害。

numeric.english: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot deals +10…22…25 damage against foes with more than 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个攻击技能会对生命值超过 50% 的敌人造成 +10…22…25 伤害。

numeric.english: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot deals +10…18…20 damage against foes with more than 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个攻击技能会对生命值超过 50% 的敌人造成 +10…18…20 伤害。

numeric.english: Spell. Interrupt target foe's skill. If that foe was suffering from a Mesmer hex, that foe and all foes in the area take 25…50 damage and have 3…5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。打断目标敌人的技能。如果该敌人正在遭受催眠术，则该敌人以及该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 25…50 伤害，并在 10 秒内造成 3…5 生命值退化。

numeric.english: Elite Hammer Attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英锤攻击。目标敌人和所有邻近的敌人都被击倒。 （锤子精通 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。在 40…60 秒内，你的元素属性提升 1 点。每次施展法术时，每 10 级能量储存，你会获得 1 点能量，并治疗 100…300% 点法术能量消耗。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英结界法术。持续 36…55…60 秒，能量增益每点最大能量，使你和目标盟友的最大生命值提高 1…3…3。当此结界首次应用时，你和你的目标获得 1…10…12 点能量。每拥有 2 点能量储存，您就会额外获得 1 点能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Target foe takes 5…41…50 fire damage. If that foe is on Fire, "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "on fire" you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 点火焰伤害。如果该敌人着火，则“Fire”大写，与其他描述“着火”不同，您将获得 5 能量加上每 2 级能量存储获得 1 能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…41…50 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a Water Magic hex, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 点寒冷伤害。如果该敌人受到水系魔法六角形的影响，你将获得 5 点能量，加上每 2 级能量储存获得 1 点能量。

numeric.english: Glyph. For 25 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 2 for your next 10 spells.
numeric.chinese: 字形。在 25 秒内，你的元素属性将在接下来的 10 个法术中提升 2 点。

numeric.english: Trap. For 10 seconds, all adjacent allies are healed for 15…51…60 every 2 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
numeric.chinese: 陷阱。在 10 秒内，所有相邻盟友每 2 秒就会被治疗 15…51…60 点。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

numeric.english: Signet. Target touched ally and up to 2…4…5 adjacent allies each lose one hex. You gain 1…3…4 Energy for each hex removed this way.
numeric.chinese: 印章。目标触及盟友，最多 2…4…5 个相邻盟友各损失 1 个降咒。通过这种方式移除每个六角形，您将获得 1…3…4 能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Create a Meteor Shower at target foe's location. For 9 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 7…91…112 fire damage and knocked down every 3 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造流星雨。在 9 秒内，该位置附近的敌人每 3 秒就会受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害并被击倒。

numeric.english: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英图章。将所有负面状态及其剩余持续时间 100…180…200% 从自己转移到目标敌人。 （诅咒 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

numeric.english: Hex Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes attack 50% slower for the next 5…25…30 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。在接下来的 5…25…30 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人的攻击速度减慢 50%。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 6 seconds, you gain 5…9…10 Health regeneration. When Shadow Refuge ends, you gain 40…88…100 Health if you are attacking.
numeric.chinese:
结界咒语。在 6 秒内，你获得 5…9…10 点生命恢复。当暗影避难所结束时，如果你正在攻击，你将获得 40…88…100 点生命值。

MAPPINGOUT_5afdf31f180dccf_0
结界咒语。你被蒙蔽了 6 秒。在 5…9…10 秒内，你获得 40…88…100 点生命恢复和 97000000003 点护甲。

numeric.english: Signet. You lose 200…80…50 Health and take control of target enemy-controlled spirit. (50% failure chance with Spawning Power 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 印章。你失去 200…80…50 点生命值并控制目标敌人控制的灵魂。 （产卵力 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

numeric.english: Spell. If target foe is Blind or moving, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Water Magic 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 咒语。如果目标敌人是盲人或正在移动，则该敌人会被击倒。 (水魔法4以下时失败率50%。)

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，每当目标盟友在接下来的 10 次攻击或法术中受到超过 50 点伤害时，该盟友就会获得 30…78…90 点生命值治疗。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，每当目标盟友在接下来的 10 次攻击或法术中受到超过 50 点伤害时，该盟友就会获得 30…78…90 点生命值治疗。

numeric.english: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…41…50 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
numeric.chinese: 武器咒语。 20 秒内，目标盟友拥有碎片武器。目标盟友接下来的 1…4…5 次攻击会对最多 4 个相邻敌人造成 5…41…50 点伤害。

numeric.english: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…33…40 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
numeric.chinese: 武器咒语。 20 秒内，目标盟友拥有碎片武器。目标盟友接下来的 1…4…5 次攻击会对最多 4 个相邻敌人造成 5…33…40 点伤害。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.
numeric.chinese:
结界咒语。在 4…9…10 秒内，每当目标盟友受到近战攻击时，所有相邻敌人都会失去所有肾上腺素和 3 能量。

MAPPINGOUT_2c028ccca6cea9b_0
技能。对于 4…9…10 第二，没有任何反应。当该技能结束时，目标盟友附近的所有敌人都会受到 3 闪电伤害。

numeric.english: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes incorrectly displays "1 foes" with Blood Magic rank 2 or below in the area.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。从最多 1…3…4 个敌人身上窃取最多 10…54…65 点生命值错误地显示该区域内血魔法等级为 2 或以下的“1 个敌人”。

numeric.english: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes in the area.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。从该地区多达 1…3…4 名敌人身上窃取多达 10…54…65 点生命值。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120…264…300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。该地区所有敌对的动画不死生物都会与你绑定。 Verata 的光环在 120…264…300 秒后结束。当维拉塔的光环结束时，你会失去与任何束缚在你身上的不死生物的联系。 (死亡魔法4以下时失败率50%。)

numeric.english: Spell. If target hostile animated undead has a master, its bond to its master is broken, making it hostile to all other creatures. If it had no master, you become its master and heal it for 60…76…80. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 咒语。如果目标敌对动画不死生物有主人，它与主人的联系就会被打破，使其对所有其他生物充满敌意。如果它没有主人，你成为它的主人并治愈它 60…76…80。（死亡魔法 4 或更少时失败几率为 50%。）

numeric.english: Elite Spell. If target foe was already suffering from a condition, that foe suffers from Disease, Poison, and Weakness for 3…13…15 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 精英法术。如果目标敌人已经患有某种病症，则该敌人将遭受疾病、毒药和虚弱的影响，持续 3…13…150 秒。

numeric.english: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of the Profane at its location. For 8…18…20 seconds, foes in that area are stripped of all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值在其位置创建一口亵渎之井。在 8…18…20 秒内，该区域的敌人将被剥夺所有结界，并且不能成为进一步结界的目标。 （死亡魔法4以下时失败率50%。）

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英法术。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 生命值。如果该盟友的生命值低于 50% 点，则额外治疗 30…98…115 点生命值。

numeric.english: Hammer Attack. Lose all adrenaline. Attack all adjacent foes. If this attack strikes a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 锤子攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。攻击所有邻近的敌人。如果此攻击击中患有某种病症的敌人，则该敌人会被击倒。 （锤子精通 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

numeric.english: Shout. (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by 20…35% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for 35…60 Health.
numeric.chinese: 喊叫。 （4 秒加上领导力每 2 级增加 1 秒。）对听力范围内的队员减少 20…35% 点伤害。最终效果：治愈 35…60 点生命值。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 15…63…75 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。造成 15…63…75 点伤害。如果目标敌人有 2 个或更多的六角形，则造成深度伤害状态（5…17…20 秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 10…30…35 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。造成 10…30…35 点伤害。如果目标敌人有 2 个或更多的六角形，则造成深度伤害状态（5…17…20 秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…24…29 fire damage each second (5 seconds) to location of target foe. Hits foes adjacent to your target. Inflicts Burning condition (3…6…7 seconds) on knocked down foes.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。每秒（5 秒）对目标敌人所在位置造成 5…24…29 点火焰伤害。攻击目标附近的敌人。对被击倒的敌人造成燃烧状态（3…6…7秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Steals 20…56…65 Health. You begin Bleeding (6 seconds) if your Health is above 90%.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。窃取 20…56…65 点生命值。如果您的生命值高于 90%，您就会开始流血（6 秒）。

numeric.english: Pet Attack. Deals +5…29…35 damage. Deals +5…29…35 more damage if target foe is under 50% health.
numeric.chinese: 宠物攻击。造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果目标敌人生命值低于 50% 点，则额外造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…21…25 damage and causes 0…2…2 Energy loss each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。每秒（10 秒）造成 5…21…25 点伤害并造成 0…2…2 点能量损失。击中目标初始位置附近的敌人。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 earth damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. Causes knock-down to foes moving faster than normal.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…34…40 点地球伤害。攻击目标初始位置附近的敌人。导致移动速度比正常速度更快的敌人被击倒。

numeric.english: Skill. You gain 0…64…80 Health and lose one hex and one condition for each enchantment on you (maximum 1…7…8 hexes and conditions). You lose all enchantments.
numeric.chinese: 技能。对于你身上的每个结界，你获得 0…64…80 点生命值并失去 1 个降咒和一个条件（最多 1…7…8 个降咒和条件）。你会失去所有的魅力。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…41…50 cold damage. Deals 5…41…50 more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 咒语。造成 5…41…50 点寒冷伤害。如果目标敌人生命值高于 50% 点，则额外造成 5…41…50 点伤害。

numeric.english: Stance. (1…4…5 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. End effect: gain one adrenaline for each melee attack skill you have (maximum 0…3…4).
numeric.chinese: 立场。 （1…4…5 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。最终效果：每拥有一项近战攻击技能，就会获得 1 点肾上腺素（最多 0…3…4）。

numeric.english: Lead Attack. Deals +15…51…60 damage if you have less than 50…74…80% Health.
numeric.chinese: 引导攻击。如果您的生命值低于 50…74…80%，则会造成 +15…51…60 点伤害。

numeric.english: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (10…30…35 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and remove one enchantment.
numeric.chinese: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命10…30…35）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并移除 1 个结界。

numeric.english: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (15…35…40 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and remove one enchantment.
numeric.chinese: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命15…35…40）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并移除 1 个结界。

numeric.english: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 10…22…25 damage every second (5 seconds). Inflicts Blindness condition (3…7…8 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Easily interrupted.
numeric.chinese: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影响附近的敌人。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…22…25 点伤害。每秒（5 秒）造成失明状态（3…7…8 秒）。很容易被打断。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (40…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。 （40…60 秒。）你的元素属性提升 1 点。每次你施展法术时，每 10 级能量储存，你就会获得 1 点能量，并获得法术能量消耗 100…300% 点的治疗效果。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) Maximum Health for you and target ally is increased by 1…3…3 for each point of maximum Energy. Initial effect: Both gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain +1 Energy for every 2 points of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英结界法术。 （36…55…60 秒。）每点最大能量，你和目标盟友的最大生命值就会增加 1…3…3。初始效果：双方获得 1…10…12 点能量。每 2 点能量存储，您将获得 +1 点能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 earth damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. Inflicts Blindness condition (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 咒语。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…34…40 点地球伤害。攻击目标初始位置附近的敌人。造成失明状态（10 秒）。

numeric.english: Hex spell. Causes 5…8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。造成 5…8 能量损失。每损失一点能量（10 秒），该区域内的目标和敌人就会有 -1 点生命值退化。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) Deals 20…56…65 lightning damage each time you create a creature to 5 foes near that creature.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。 （15…51…60 秒。）每次你创造一个生物时，都会对该生物附近的 5 个敌人造成 20…56…65 点闪电伤害。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. You gain 30…126…150 Health the next time damage drops your Health below 50%.
numeric.chinese: 结界咒语。下次伤害使您的生命值低于 50% 时，您将获得 30…126…150 生命值。

numeric.english: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 lifespan). Deals 20…60…70 damage to creatures in range that reach 0 energy. Does not affect spirits.

numeric.english:
* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
numeric.chinese:
* 结合回声和奥术回声来创建回声链，允许您使用任何单一技能的三个副本。
* 如果奥术回响之后的下一个技能不是法术，则该结界将结束且没有任何效果。
* 奥术回响只有在没有复制法术的情况下才会正常充电。如果法术被复制，则该副本会保留 20 秒，之后奥术回响将被禁用 20 秒。
** 考虑在奥术回响之前使用吉祥咒进行能量管理，因为充能时间不会增加。
* 如果用于复制可以复制其他技能或法术的法术，则使用该法术的复制持续时间，并将绕过奥术回响的 20 秒复制持续时间。
** 例如，如果用于复制回声，则奥术回声版本的回声所复制的任何技能都将保留为该技能 30 秒，然后恢复为奥术回声。
*奥术回响的复制效果首先触发，然后才是触发它的法术效果。例如，当用于复制健康之礼时，该复制会因健康之礼的效果而失效。
奥术回响的描述忽略了它无法复制自身的事实。
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。

numeric.english:
* The caster receives the Death Penalty reduction when the hexed foe dies, regardless of who delivered the killing blow.
* If you kill a boss hexed with Asuran Scan, the order of effects is to your favor. You will first lose 5% Death Penalty and then gain the morale boost.
* This hex only applies to attacks that would be blocked and attacks affected by Blindness or skill effects that cause attacks to miss; it does not prevent hits from straying, being obstructed, or being dodged. It also does not prevent failure due to unmet requirements, e.g. Oath Shot will still fail 50% of the time if Expertise is below 8, and lead, off-hand, and dual attacks must still be executed in the correct sequence.
* This is the only hex without a specified activation time. It casts instantly, but it has an aftercast delay and cannot be used in mid-action.

Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.

While target foe is hexed, you cannot miss other foes.

This hex also prevents the target from blocking your attacks.
numeric.chinese:
* 当施咒的敌人死亡时，无论是谁造成了致命一击，施法者都会获得死刑减免。
* 如果你杀死了一个被阿苏兰扫描诅咒的 Boss，效果的顺序对你有利。你将首先失去5%死刑，然后获得士气提升。
* 此降咒仅适用于会被格挡的攻击以及受失明或技能效果影响而导致攻击失败的攻击；它不能防止命中偏离、被阻挡或被躲避。它也不能防止由于未满足要求而导致的失败，例如如果专长低于8，誓言射击仍有50%次失败，并且主攻、副手和双重攻击仍然必须以正确的顺序执行。
* 这是唯一没有指定激活时间的降咒。它会立即施法，但有施法后的延迟，无法在行动中使用。

受此技能影响的敌人不会失手。

当目标敌人被施咒时，你不会错过其他敌人。

这个六角形还可以防止目标阻挡你的攻击。

numeric.english:
* Dash boosts speed enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 18.75% if used every time it recharges.
** Combine with Dwarven Stability for up to 6 seconds speed boost every 8 seconds and up to 37.5% average speed boost.
* Despite being linked to an Attribute, this skill does not benefit from that attribute in any way.
numeric.chinese:
* 冲刺的速度提升足以让角色通过并触发陷阱而不受影响。
* 该技能每次充能时使用，平均速度增加18.75%。
** 与矮人稳定性结合，每 8 秒速度提升高达 6 秒，平均速度提升高达 37.5% 秒。
* 尽管与某个属性相关联，但该技能不会以任何方式从该属性中受益。

numeric.english:
* When used against Charr, the Ebon Vanguard Assassin can survive long enough to complete up to two attack chains. When used against other foes, the Assassin only has enough time for a single attack chain.
** All its skills are unblockable
** His Iron Palm will knock down foes that are hexed or suffering from a condition.
* You can create multiple Assassins in an area.
* It is not infused nor does it leave an exploitable corpse.
* When its summoning period ends, it appears to Shadow Step into nothingness.
* It will be higher than level 20 if cast under the effects of Signet of Illusions with an Illusion Magic rank 17 or more.

The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.
The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.
The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.
Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.
numeric.chinese:
* 当用于对抗夏尔时，黑锋先锋刺客可以存活足够长的时间来完成最多两个攻击链。当用于对抗其他敌人时，刺客只有足够的时间进行单一攻击链。
** 所有技能均不可阻挡
** 他的铁掌会击倒被施咒或患有某种疾病的敌人。
* 你可以在一个区域创建多个刺客。
* 它不会被注入，也不会留下可利用的尸体。
* 当它的召唤期结束时，它会出现在暗影步虚无中。
* 如果在幻象魔法等级17以上的幻象徽记的效果下施展，等级将高于20。

刺客不会暗影步；它直接在目标旁边生成。
刺客被视为精神恩赐、爆炸性成长和创造恩赐的创造生物。然而，它不算是召唤生物，也不受产卵力影响。尽管有这样的分类，但它不受硫的影响。
虽然刺客不计入小兵上限，但召唤一名刺客会导致游戏检查玩家的小兵控制限制，可能会摧毁任何超过限制的小兵。
刺客并不总是以施法者所瞄准的敌人为目标，而是以最接近其创造点的敌人为目标。
极少数情况下，刺客可能会无限期地生存。如果被敌人创造的恢复精魂复活，比如重生的伊鲁坎吉，就会发生这种情况。

numeric.english:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* The effect stacks with other skills that boost attributes.
* The Energy Storage-dependent gain is rounded down, i.e. you receive no energy unless you have at least rank 10 in the attribute and can receive at most 2 energy with rank 20 or higher.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
numeric.chinese:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 该效果可与其他提升属性的技能叠加。
* 取决于能量存储的增益向下取整，即除非您的属性等级至少为 10，否则您不会收到能量，并且等级 20 或更高时最多可以收到 2 能量。
* 此结界的治疗效果仅考虑法术的基本消耗，没有任何修饰符，例如弱能雕文或加速和风。

numeric.english:
* This skill increases average speed by 11.67% if used every time it recharges. 
* This can be maintained indefinitely with Extend Enchantments at Mysticism 11 (or 9 when using a 20% of Enchanting weapon).
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能每次充能时使用，平均速度增加11.67%。 
* 这可以通过延长附魔在神秘主义 11（或使用 20% 附魔武器时为 9）无限期地维持。

numeric.english:
Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Consider combining with Signet of Illusions if your allegiance rank is low and your Illusion Magic rank is high.
numeric.chinese:
与描述相反，无论能量损失多少，该技能都会在 10 秒内造成该区域 -5…8 点生命值退化。
* 达到第一效忠等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 如果你的忠诚等级较低而你的幻象魔法等级较高，请考虑与幻象徽记结合使用。

numeric.english: bug: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
numeric.chinese: bug：与描述相反，无论能量损失多少，该技能都会在 10 秒内造成该区域 -5…8 点生命值退化。

numeric.english:
* This skill will cause maximum health degeneration at rank 14 and above.
* The healing effect scales to be ~50% of the hex's maximum damage potential. For example, at rank 12, the skill will inflict a maximum of 216 damage, healing 113 points when it ends.
* You can increase the duration of the hex, increasing the net damage without affecting the amount of healing:
** Using Mantra of Persistence. (+1/2/3 seconds at 0/8/11 Inspiration Magic, respectively)
** By re-applying the hex before it runs out. 
* Removing the hex early (e.g. via Cure Hex) will trigger the healing. Use a cover hex to prevent this.
* The healing caused by Illusion of Pain does not trigger Scourge Healing.
* The AI only uses this skill on targets whose health is below two thirds of maximum.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能在等级 14 及以上时将导致最大生命值退化。
* 治疗效果约为六角形最大潜在伤害的 50%。例如，等级12时，该技能最多会造成216点伤害，结束时治疗113点。
* 你可以增加六角形的持续时间，增加净伤害而不影响治疗量：
** 使用坚持的咒语。 （0/8/11 灵感魔法分别为 +1/2/3 秒）
** 在六角形用完之前重新应用六角形。 
* 尽早移除六角形（例如通过治愈六角形）将触发愈合。使用六角盖可以防止这种情况发生。
* 痛苦幻象造成的治疗不会触发天灾治疗。
* AI仅对生命值低于最大值三分之二的目标使用此技能。

numeric.english:
The effects of this skill apply to all spells, regardless of target or attribute.
* It takes 6s to recover from 2 points of overcast. If you cast more than three spells while under the effect of this enchantment, you will not be able to completely recover from this skill's overcast during its recharge.
** If you are concerned about building up too much overcast, consider a lower attribute investment and shorter enchantment duration. Only use the spells that really need the reduced casting time and recharge time while enchanted by Iron Mist. Cast your other spells when this enchantment has worn off. Non-spell skills can be activated any time. Alternatively, use Soul Ignition to recover from Overcast.
* The overcast caused by this skill is not increased by Equinox, and not prevented by Glyph of Energy.
* The overcast caused by casting a spell is applied in time to trigger that spell’s additional effects.
numeric.chinese:
该技能的效果适用于所有法术，无论目标或属性如何。
* 从 2 点阴天恢复需要 6 秒。如果你在该结界的效果下施展了三个以上的法术，你将无法在充能期间完全从该技能的阴暗状态中恢复。
** 如果您担心建立过多的阴暗，请考虑较低的属性投资和较短的结界持续时间。只使用那些在被铁雾附魔时确实需要减少施法时间和充能时间的法术。当这个结界消失后，施展你的其他咒语。非法术技能可以随时激活。或者，使用灵魂点燃从阴暗中恢复。
* 该技能造成的阴霾不会被春分点增加，也不会被能量雕文阻止。
* 施展法术造成的阴霾会及时应用，以触发该法术的附加效果。

numeric.english:
* The triggering damage is calculated before damage reduction, so a 55 Monk enchanted with Protective Spirit and Judge's Intervention could be dealt 60 damage, have that reduced to 5 damage, and still trigger Judge's Intervention.

* Combines well with minions, but will not trigger if they die due to their natural health degeneration.
* This skill can cause the highest armor-ignoring damage in one packet amongst all player-useable skills; however, Grenth's Balance can potentially cause a foe to lose more health.
Unlike most other monk spells, Judge's Intervention does not invoke an animation upon the target.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
* Heroes will use it on allies who have low health and are not in combat, such as minions when travelling between mobs.
numeric.chinese:
* 触发伤害是在伤害减免之前计算的，所以一个55的武僧附魔有护灵和审判者干预，可以造成60点伤害，减少到5点伤害，仍然会触发审判者干预。

* 与小兵配合良好，但如果他们因自然健康退化而死亡，则不会触发。
* 该技能在所有玩家可用技能中可以造成最高的一包无视护甲伤害；然而，格伦斯的平衡可能会导致敌人失去更多生命值。
与大多数其他武僧法术不同，审判者干预不会对目标调用动画​​。
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。
* 英雄会将其用于生命值较低且未参与战斗的盟友，例如在小怪之间旅行时的小兵。

numeric.english:
*This spell's area of effect is determined when the spell is cast. As such, becoming Overcast while Lava Font is still in effect will not enlarge the area of an already cast font, nor will the spell's area be reduced partway through its duration by the caster's Overcast disappearing.

{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
Hero AI will use this spell without considering whether there are foes adjacent to them.
numeric.chinese:
*该法术的效果范围是在施放该法术时确定的。因此，在熔岩字体仍然有效时变为阴暗不会扩大已施放字体的面积，法术的面积也不会在施法者的阴暗消失的过程中减少。

{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。
英雄 AI 将使用此法术，而不考虑附近是否有敌人。

numeric.english:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Life.
* This spirit heals 120-180 health throughout its lifespan with 12 ranks (or higher) in Restoration Magic.
** Effective when used with skills which reduces skill recharge time and/or destroys spirits to control the healing spike.
** Life will heal for 60-90 health if refreshed every 10 seconds upon recharge (with Ritual Lord).
* This spirit will also heal allied NPCs and members of allied parties, making it effective in large or multi party missions, especially with multiple minion masters since it also heals any allied minions.
This skill will create a spirit with an offensive appearance.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能创造生命之灵。
* 该灵魂在其生命周期内可治愈 120-180 点生命值，恢复魔法等级为 12 级（或更高）。
** 与减少技能恢复时间和/或摧毁灵魂以控制治疗峰值的技能一起使用时有效。
** 如果在充能后每 10 秒刷新一次，生命将恢复 60-90 点生命值（使用仪式领主）。
* 这种精神还会治愈盟军 NPC 和盟军成员，使其在大型或多方任务中有效，尤其是在多个小兵大师的情况下，因为它还可以治疗任何盟军小兵。
该技能会创造出具有攻击性外观的精灵。

numeric.english:
* This skill overrides any existing modifiers, including: skills that boost elemental attributes (e.g. Elemental Lord), runes, Weakness and consumables (e.g. Candy Corn).
** Bonuses will take effect if they are applied after Master of Magic (e.g. remove/reapply headgear before casting).
***Removing and reapplying runes has no effect.
** Renewing Master of Magic whilst under the attribute boosting modifiers will retain the higher attribute ranks and not reset them to the rank predicted by Master of Magic.
** Renewing Master of Magic while boosted by Heroic Refrain will cause the boost to not be renewed even if the echo is renewed. Recast Heroic Refrain immediately after renewing Master of Magic.
* Journey to the North takes precedence, setting only one attribute to 12 (and any others to 9). [Source claim needs verification]
* The most effective uses of this skill are:
** To boost the effectiveness of low-level characters, since it can allow them to reach and maintain an elemental attribute rank of 9 at only rank 3 in Energy Storage. 
** To maximize the strength of Prismatic Insignia (raising an elementalist's armor by 20).
** To free attribute points for builds that draw on several elementalist attributes or to meet the requirement of certain weapons (notably shields).
* The amount of energy regained is rounded down: 5 energy spells return 1 energy, 15 energy spells return 4 and 25 energy spells return 7.
* The amount of energy regained considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
* Elemental spells refers to spells associated with the four elemental attributes, rather than spells that deal elemental damage.
While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能会覆盖任何现有的修饰符，包括：提升元素属性的技能（例如元素领主）、符文、弱点和消耗品（例如玉米糖）。
** 如果在魔法大师之后应用，奖励将生效（例如在施法前移除/重新戴上头饰）。
***移除并重新应用符文没有效果。
** 在属性提升修改器下更新魔法大师将保留较高的属性等级，并且不会将其重置为魔法大师预测的等级。
** 在英雄副歌强化的同时更新魔法大师将导致即使回声更新也不会更新强化效果。续订魔法大师后立即重铸英雄副歌。
* 北游记优先，仅将一项属性设置为 12（将任何其他属性设置为 9）。 [来源声明需要验证]
* 该技能最有效的用途是：
** 提升低等级角色的效率，因为它可以让他们在能量存储中仅达到3级，就达到并保持元素属性等级9。 
** 最大化棱柱徽章的强度（将元素师的护甲提高 20）。
** 为利用多种元素属性的构建释放属性点或满足某些武器（尤其是盾牌）的要求。
* 恢复的能量数量向下取整：5 能量法术返回 1 能量，15 能量法术返回 4，25 能量法术返回 7。
* 恢复的能量量仅考虑法术的基本成本，没有任何修饰符，例如次级能量雕文或加速和风。
* 元素法术是指与四种元素属性相关的法术，而不是造成元素伤害的法术。
在魔法大师的效果下，元素等级属性点被削弱，会导致元素等级降低1。没有属性点的元素属性不会降低1。

numeric.english:
* It is best used as a sustained, passive self-healing skill, e.g. for navigating areas with health degeneration or numerous interrupts.
* It is a prominent optional component of 55 monk builds.
* It heals very slowly compared to other healing spells; however, it has relatively high healing when compared to other healing spells. For every 5 energy lost by the -1 energy degeneration, it heals for 90 health at rank 8 and 120 at rank 13.
numeric.chinese:
* 它最好用作持续、被动的自我修复技能，例如用于在健康状况恶化或多次中断的区域中导航。
* 它是 55 武僧构建的一个突出的可选组件。
* 与其他治疗法术相比，它的治疗速度非常慢；然而，与其他治疗法术相比，它具有相对较高的治疗效果。 -1 能量衰退每损失 5 点能量，就能治愈 8 级的 90 点生命值和 13 级的 120 点生命值。

numeric.english:
* This skill only recharges Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet or Celestial skills if they were disabled by another skill (e.g. by Distracting Shot); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* This skill is sometimes used by trappers, as it allows them to plant another set of traps or nature rituals without waiting out the long recharge time.
* Combine with Determined Shot, which recharges all your attack skills if it fails to hit. This can be used to rapidly recharge Oath Shot.
** This tactic can be extended with Shadow Sanctuary, which almost guarantees a miss.
** Add "Dodge This!" or Asuran Scan to the skill chain to ensure that Oath Shot hits through block and/or blind, bear in mind it will still have a 50% chance to miss when below 8 Expertise.
* The 50% miss chance is actually a 50% fail chance and cannot be prevented with effects such as Asuran Scan. Oath Shot will still go into recharge, unlike in regular attack skill failure.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能仅在复活徽记、阳矛重生徽记或天界技能被其他技能（例如分散射击）禁用时才对其进行充能；如果使用成功，则不会为其充电。
* 捕兽者有时会使用此技能，因为它允许他们设置另一组陷阱或自然仪式，而无需等待漫长的充电时间。
* 与决心射击相结合，如果没有击中，它会为你的所有攻击技能重新充电。这可以用来快速充能誓言射击。
** 这个战术可以用暗影庇护所来扩展，几乎保证会失手。
** 添加“躲避这个！”或阿苏兰 扫描技能链以确保誓言射击击穿格挡和/或盲区，请记住，当专业知识低于 8 时，它仍然有 50% 的机会错过。
* 50% 失败机会实际上是 50% 失败机会，并且无法通过阿苏兰扫描等效果来阻止。与普通攻击技能失败不同，誓言射击仍然会进入充能状态。

numeric.english:
* If used as soon and as efficiently (i.e., not going over maximum energy) as possible, this skill nets the equivalent of +2 pips of energy regeneration at 11-12 Channeling Magic and 2.4 pips at 15 Channeling Magic.
* Spirit Siphon will usually be superior to Offering of Spirit when spirits are available. It is non-elite, only returns 2 less energy than Offering of Spirit at rank 12 or higher, but can be used potentially more often resulting in more energy overall.
numeric.chinese:
* 如果尽快有效地使用（即，不超过最大能量），该技能在 11-12 通道魔法时可获得相当于 +2 点的能量再生，在 15 通道魔法时相当于 2.4 点的能量再生。
* 当有烈酒可用时，烈酒虹吸通常会优于烈酒奉献。它不是精英，仅比等级 12 或更高的精神奉献少返回 2 能量，但可以更频繁地使用，从而产生更多能量。

numeric.english:
* Burning is refreshed every second that Ray of Judgment is active, e.g. a stationary target might burn as long as 7 seconds from a ray cast with a Smiting Prayers rank of 12 to 18.

Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
numeric.chinese:
* 审判之光激活时每秒都会刷新燃烧，例如一个静止的目标可能会因重击祈祷等级为 12 到 18 的射线投射而燃烧长达 7 秒。

与其他反复出现的地面 AOE 技能不同，AI 单位通常不会在效果快要过期之前尝试离开。

numeric.english: * With this skill at 11 or more Healing Prayers, a party member is able to resurrect a 55 Monk even when the 55 Monk is at 1 maximum health due to Death Penalty (see 55 Monk for more details).
numeric.chinese: * 凭借此技能，在治愈祈祷数达到 11 或更多时，即使 55 武僧因死刑而处于 1 最大生命值，队员也能够复活 55 武僧（更多详情请参阅 55 武僧）。

numeric.english:
* Damage inflicted by this skill is considered holy damage.
* If the target takes more damage than the stated maximum, then the damage taken will be reduced by that maximum and the attacker will receive the same amount. For example, at 14 Smiting Prayers, a target with Reversal of Damage on them being struck by a Lightning Orb that would deal 100 damage would take 30 damage and the attacker would take 70.
* The damage for this reversal is calculated before other damage reduction. So, a 55 Monk using Protective Spirit and Reversal of Damage can deal more than five damage, with the remaining (above the stated maximum for this skill) damage being reduced by Protective Spirit.
* This skill will still prevent damage even if there is no foe to redirect damage to, for example when struck by environmental damage.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能造成的伤害被视为神圣伤害。
* 如果目标受到的伤害超过规定的最大伤害，则受到的伤害将减少该最大伤害，而攻击者将受到相同的伤害。例如，在 14 次重击祈祷中，一个受到伤害逆转的目标被造成 100 点伤害的闪电球击中时，将受到 30 点伤害，而攻击者将受到 70 点伤害。
* 此逆转的伤害是在其他伤害减免之前计算的。因此，使用防护精神和伤害逆转的 55 武僧可以造成超过 5 点伤害，剩余的（高于该技能规定的最大伤害）伤害会被防护精神减少。
* 即使没有敌人可以将伤害重定向到该技能，例如受到环境伤害时，该技能仍然可以防止伤害。

numeric.english:
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of Comfort Animal.
* As of the August 6, 2009 game update and August 26, 2026 game update, Comfort Animal or Comfort Animal (PvP) can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you. Heal as One was updated with the February 25, 2010 game update to also have this functionality in PvE. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能的范围比安慰动物的复活范围短得多。
* 自 8 月 6、2009 游戏更新和 8 月 26、2026 游戏更新起，可以使用舒适动物或舒适动物（PvP）代替魅惑动物，让您的同伴与您同行。 《Heal as One》在 2 月的 25、2010 游戏更新中进行了更新，在 PvE 中也具有此功能。这些更新在很大程度上使复活动物变得次优，因为它们复活宠物的能力、宠物使用的强制栏位置、施法时间、充电时间、宠物治疗和范围。

numeric.english:
* You gain energy and health from this skill’s own overcast cost.
* You can quickly build up overcast to a useful amount by activating and canceling this skill a few times.
* This spell takes fractional points of overcast into account. For example, if you cast this skill while you’re not otherwise overcast, you will gain 5 points of overcast as you start casting it. By the time you finish casting it, you will have already regenerated 0.3333333333333333 points of overcast and this skill will give you only 4 energy and 23 health, not 5 energy and 25 health.
* It takes 15 seconds to fully recover from this skill’s overcast cost and maintain a stable level of overcast. When cast every 15 seconds, this skill gives the equivalent of 1 pip of energy regeneration for every 5 points of overcast. For ease of calculation and because fractional points of overcast aren’t visible in the user interface, this table ignores the 0.3333333333333333 point of overcast lost during this skill’s activation time.

numeric.english:
*The damage is delivered in three independent packets. Adjacent foes are hit three times, nearby foes twice, and foes in the area only once.
**One-time damage reduction skills, such as Reversal of Fortune, and damage cappers, such Protective Spirit, do not fully protect against this skill, however skills that protect against multiple packets, such as Union, are more effective.
**Pain Inverter will deal damage back for each packet.
*Cracked Armor is applied before any damage.
The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
numeric.chinese:
*损坏的物品以三个独立的包裹交付。相邻的敌人会被击中 3 次，附近的敌人会被击中两次，而该区域内的敌人只会被击中一次。
**一次性减伤技能，如逆运，以及伤害封顶，如守护之灵，并不能完全防御该技能，但防御多个包的技能，如联盟，效果更佳。
**疼痛逆变器将为每个数据包造成伤害。
*破裂的护甲是在任何伤害之前应用的。
技能描述暗示“盲”覆盖了“破甲”，而“破甲”又覆盖了“弱点”，而实际上“盲”覆盖了“弱点”，而“弱点”又覆盖了“破甲”。

numeric.english:
* You lose exactly 8 energy from the -4 pips over 6 seconds.
* If the signet is renewed before it ends, the caster will gain energy for each time the skill was activated.
* This skill will provide more total energy gain per second than Ether Signet.
* Signet of Recall is particularly useful:
**When encountering heavy energy denial, e.g. from a Mursaat Tower (the energy degeneration from Signet of Recall will have no effect since your energy has already been depleted).
**When you already have Ether Signet on your skill bar and need even more energy without having to use skills that require energy. 
**When you are facing many short battles (since Signet of Recall can be used right before the battle, during which time the energy degeneration is not disadvantageous).
**When energy hiding, you will not lose any energy from this skill while your current energy is 0.
numeric.chinese:
* 在 6 秒内，您从 -4 点中损失了 8 能量。
* 如果印章在结束前被更新，施法者每次激活技能都会获得能量。
* 该技能每秒提供的总能量增益比以太印章更多。
* 召回徽记特别有用：
**当遇到严重的能量拒绝时，例如来自穆尔萨塔（Mursaat Tower）（召回徽记的能量退化将不起作用，因为你的能量已经耗尽）。
**当你的技能栏上已经有以太印章并且需要更多能量而不必使用需要能量的技能时。 
**当你面临很多短暂的战斗时（因为召回徽记可以在战斗前使用，在此期间能量衰退并不不利）。
**能量隐藏时，当前能量为0时，该技能不会损失任何能量。

numeric.english:
* This skill loses charges depending on the number of foes struck, not the number of swings. For example, if Signet of Strength had 5 charges (Strength attribute of 4) and a Warrior using it used Cyclone Axe against five foes, all five charges of Signet of Strength would be expended in a single swing.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能损失的能量取决于击中敌人的数量，而不是挥动的次数。例如，如果力量徽记有 5 个冲锋（力量属性为 4），并且使用它的战士使用旋风斧对抗 5 个敌人，则力量徽记的所有 5 个冲锋将在一次挥击中消耗掉。
* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。

numeric.english:
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
* AI seems to cast it on targets with at least one adrenaline skill.
* This skill may actually increase the Black Bear's damage per second by effectively preventing the use of Brutal Mauling.
numeric.chinese:
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。
* AI似乎会将其施放于至少具有一项肾上腺素技能的目标上。
* 该技能实际上可以通过有效防止野蛮猛击的使用来增加黑熊的每秒伤害。

numeric.english:
* The health gain at 12 Restoration Magic equals a health regeneration of 10.5 pips (21 pips within earshot of a spirit) and 13 pips at 16 Restoration Magic (26 pips within earshot of a spirit).
* Heroes will cast Spirit Light Weapon to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's health is at critical levels.

Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
numeric.chinese:
* 12 恢复魔法时的健康增益等于 10.5 点（在灵魂的听力范围内 21 点）和 16 恢复魔法时的 13 点（在灵魂的听力范围内 26 点）的生命恢复。
* 当目标生命值处于临界水平时，英雄会施放灵光武器来覆盖非防御性武器法术。

与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

numeric.english:
* Spirits have four pips of energy regeneration; they regain their maximum energy (30 energy) in about 23 seconds.
** In Hard mode, enemy spirits have 41 energy, making them a better source.
** Spirits do not use energy to attack, so Spirit Siphon will not reduce their effectiveness.
* When used on multiple spirits, this skill allows for better energy returns over Offering of Spirit or Signet of Spirits (PvP).
* This skill always targets the spirit closest to the caster. If two or more spirits are equal distance, the target is chosen at random.
** There is no effect unless the closest spirit is within casting range; however, the skill will activate (and waste energy) with spirits outside of casting range or without spirits at all.
numeric.chinese:
* 精神有四点能量再生；他们在大约 23 秒内恢复最大能量（30 能量）。
** 在困难模式下，敌方灵魂拥有 41 能量，使它们成为更好的来源。
** 灵魂不使用能量进行攻击，因此灵魂虹吸不会降低其效果。
* 当对多个灵魂使用时，该技能比灵魂献祭或灵魂徽记（PvP）有更好的能量回报。
* 该技能总是以距离施法者最近的灵魂为目标。如果两个或多个灵魂距离相等，则随机选择目标。
** 除非最近的灵魂在施法范围内，否则没有效果；然而，当灵魂超出施法范围或根本没有灵魂时，该技能将激活（并浪费能量）。

numeric.english:
* Combat stats at level 20 (rank 5 or above): 
** It will normally do three attacks between Stoning with one cast every 6 seconds. However, it benefits from its staff's chance for half recharge time of spells 20% of the time. On these occasions it will complete its second normal attack at 2.625 seconds before casting Stoning again (see Activation Time and Attack speed). 
** Its normal attacks deal between 16 and 46 earth damage on targets with 60 armor, and can benefit from weapon spells.
** It has 15 in Earth Magic.
** It has enough energy to use stoning 10 times during its lifespan, and will use it 9-10 times depending on the staff's recharge effect. As such, using a skill that reduces recharge time, like Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom, will not have any noticable effect unless combined with a skill that grants energy. 
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Naga is not infused against Spectral Agony.
* Its Stoning works best if one or more members of the party inflict Weakness on targets. However, it will not always cast the spell on weakened foes.
* It is considered a non-spirit ally.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
numeric.chinese:
* 20级战斗统计（5级或以上）： 
** 它通常会在石击之间进行 3 次攻击，每 6 秒施放一次。然而，它受益于其员工有机会获得当时法术 20% 一半的充能时间。在这些情况下，它会在 2.625 秒完成第二次普通攻击，然后再次施放石击（参见激活时间和攻击速度）。 
** 它的普通攻击对护甲值 60 的目标造成 16 到 46 点土属性伤害，并且可以从武器法术中受益。
** 土系魔法有15。
** 生命周期内能量足以使用石击10次，根据法杖的充能效果会使用9-10次。因此，使用减少充能时间的技能，如智慧黑锋战旗，除非与赋予能量的技能结合使用，否则不会产生任何明显的效果。 
* 当召唤物死亡时，它会留下一具不可利用的尸体。 
* 召唤的娜迦不会注入对抗幽灵痛苦的能力。
* 如果队伍中的一名或多名成员对目标造成虚弱，则石击效果最佳。然而，它并不总是对虚弱的敌人施展该法术。
* 它被认为是非精神盟友。

该描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。

numeric.english:
While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.
Contrary to other skills dealing Area damage over time (such as Fire Storm), this skill will fail if the target dies before the spell finishes casting.
numeric.chinese:
虽然该法术的功能在 6 月 24、2026 更新中发生了变化，但其动画却没有变化。没有可见的动画来突出显示新的效果区域。
与其他随时间造成区域伤害的技能（例如火焰风暴）相反，如果目标在法术施法完成之前死亡，则该技能将会失败。

numeric.english: bug: While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.
numeric.chinese: bug：虽然该法术的功能在 6 月 24、2026 更新中发生了变化，但其动画却没有变化。没有可见的动画来突出显示新的效果区域。

numeric.english:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Bonus damage (i.e. from Conjure spells, Glass Arrows and certain weapon spells) is not reduced.
* Even with the large damage reduction per arrow at rank 1, Triple Shot will still do more damage than Dual Shot under normal circumstances.
The base attack damage from this skill is 50...35% less damage rather than the 40...25% stated.
numeric.chinese:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 额外伤害（即来自召唤法术、玻璃箭和某些武器法术的伤害）不会减少。
* 即使在等级 1 时每支箭的伤害大幅降低，正常情况下三重射击仍会比双箭造成更多伤害。
该技能的基础攻击伤害比规定的 40...25% 少 50...35%。

numeric.english: bug: The base attack damage from this skill is 50...35% less damage rather than the 40...25% stated.
numeric.chinese: bug：该技能的基础攻击力比规定的 40...25% 少 50...35%。

numeric.english:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Vampirism that uses the Vampirism attack skill.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal life, so it does not receive the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might.
* The amount which you are healed will always be the same because Vampirism heals you. The amount of health left on a target only affects how much the spirit is healed by the life stealing, not how much you are healed. Therefore, additional life stealing from Spiritleech Aura does not give additional healing to you.

Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. Therefore, the heal is unaffected by hexes that reduce healing such as Lingering Curse or Defile Flesh, and the spirit will not take damage from healer-punishing hexes such as Scourge Healing or Soul Bind.

The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.

The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.
numeric.chinese:
* 该技能会创造出使用吸血鬼攻击技能的吸血鬼之魂。
* 该精魂使用的攻击会窃取生命，因此不会受到鬼威徽记的额外伤害。
* 你得到的治疗量将始终相同，因为吸血鬼会治愈你。目标上剩余的生命值只影响灵魂被生命窃取所治愈的程度，而不影响你被治愈的程度。因此，从吸灵光环中窃取额外的生命不会给你带来额外的治疗效果。

与描述相反，该技能的治疗是通过生命窃取而不是治疗获得的。因此，治疗不会受到诸如“挥之不去的诅咒”或“玷污肉体”等减少治疗效果的咒语的影响，并且灵魂也不会受到诸如“天灾治疗”或“灵魂束缚”等惩罚治疗者的咒语的伤害。

治疗的距离远远大于精神范围，似乎治疗覆盖了当前的所有位置。

吸血鬼之魂的攻击技能是与阳矛等级无关的怪物技能。与 5 月 17、2012 更新后其他烈阳之矛技能的进展不同，吸血鬼主义的生命窃取继续遵循该更新之前的进展（即在阳矛等级 10 而不是 5 时达到最大效果），尽管描述显示从等级 5 到 9 有 20 生命窃取。

numeric.english: bug: The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.
numeric.chinese: bug：吸血鬼之魂的攻击技能是与阳矛等级无关的怪物技能。与 5 月 17、2012 更新后其他烈阳之矛技能的进展不同，吸血鬼主义的生命窃取继续遵循该更新之前的进展（即在阳矛等级 10 而不是 5 时达到最大效果），尽管描述显示从等级 5 到 9 有 20 生命窃取。

numeric.chinese:
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。

numeric.english: * The shortest recharging weapon spell (with a recharge time of 1s) is Ghostly Weapon. Since the rank in Communing affects only Ghostly Weapon's duration, it can be used effectively even at 0 Communing. Other short recharging item spells are Vital Weapon (2s), Vengeful Weapon, Weapon of Remedy and Xinrae's Weapon (3s). The activation time is of 1/4s for all those skills except Vital Weapon (1s). Other weapon spells that synergize with Wielder's Remedy have a recharge time of at least 5s for a casting time of 1s.
numeric.chinese: * 充能最短的武器法术（充能时间为1秒）是幽灵武器。由于交流的等级只影响鬼兵的持续时间，因此即使在0交流时也能有效使用。其他短时间充电物品法术包括重要武器（2s）、复仇武器、治疗武器和辛莱武器（3s）。除致命武器（1秒）外，所有技能的激活时间均为1/4秒。其他与持用药剂协同作用的武器法术的充电时间至少为 5 秒，施法时间为 1 秒。
